# MAGA's Project 2025: Attacking American Sustainability
---
| [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)
---
_**MAGA's Project 2025 is attacking American progress.**_ As detailed in the Project 2025 writings, MAGA wants to completely destroy all of the progress made in climate policy over the last 15 years! **WE NEED TO CALL THIS OUT!** 🚨 Here is one of the many direct quotes attacking sustainable policy: **"The next Administration should eliminate the Climate Hub Office and withdraw from climate change agreements that are inimical to the prosperity of the United States."** As outlined in the Project, the next Administration is encouraged to eliminate the Climate Hub Office and withdraw from climate change agreements perceived as detrimental to the prosperity of the United States. However, this shortsighted approach prioritizes short-term economic gains over the long-term sustainability of our planet, basically upending years of positive progress made on the environment. By dismantling initiatives aimed at combating climate change and withdrawing from international agreements, Project 2025 poses a grave threat to the health and well-being of future generations as well as the planet as a whole. The consequences of inaction on climate change are dire, and we cannot afford to ignore the urgent need for action. It is imperative that we come together to oppose Project 2025's regressive stance on climate change and advocate for policies that prioritize environmental sustainability. Our planet and future generations depend on it. We can make a more sustainable future with sustainable policy. This is something all Americans can agree on: we need to protect our environment at all costs. Together, we can make sure our government prioritizes our environment over profits for the elite. [**Join us in this critical battle to protect our nation from Trump’s authoritarian ambitions. Together, we can preserve the very essence of American democracy. **Peter, following Trump’s election in 2016, I decided to return to my home state of Arizona because I knew democracy was on the line.** For years, I had dedicated my life to fighting the climate crisis — as a senior policy advisor at the United Nations, as the deputy policy director for the Global Climate Action Summit, and on the climate team for California Governor Jerry Brown. I helped deliver the Paris Climate Agreement, helped cities and states across the country achieve their climate goals, and helped persuade more than 20 big tech companies to sign onto decarbonization goals. **And I was tired of watching Donald Trump do everything in his power to dismantle the progress we had fought so hard to make. When he pulled out of the Paris Accords, it was the final straw.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85388444/474600622/2145040083?refcode=240521_ya_accomplishments_img&ms=240521_ya_story&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTllZmE3My1kMDE3LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wUvtDlgYV3AwxXHzms276fLoK2pdp4s02IOJyUHvPpY=) So we got to work. We built a grassroots campaign that knocked on more than 100,000 doors in Phoenix, and built strong relationships with people in every corner of our community. When we won, I had the honor of becoming the youngest woman ever elected to the Phoenix City Council, and the first Iranian-American to hold public office in Arizona. **And together, we turned one of the "least sustainable cities on the planet" into a leader in progressive climate and housing policy.** We passed one of the most ambitious fleet transition plans in the country, committing to net-zero emissions by 2040. We added hundreds of permanent beds to our shelter system, advanced new affordable housing initiatives, and pioneered new programs to keep Arizonans safe from extreme heat. There's so much more work to be done, Peter. I'm taking this same fight to Congress, because our community needs a progressive voice in Washington — someone who listens to us, fights for us, and has the experience delivering the results that we need. With your support, that's the kind of Congresswoman I'll be. name: Josh Harder

body:
My thoughts.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85388488/474601360/-1463099547?refcode=-header-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzEyNGE1ODAtZDAxNy1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Hbg3HCHc2HKyUPFUZs7IN3hWLYbXidl_UUnj5UmOJfA=) | Peter, Did you see this? Last night a bunch of people started texting me that I had to watch Donald Trump’s new campaign video. The premise seemed like a typical politician video - imagining what the country would be like if he won a 2nd term. I wasn’t super interested. Turns out, I should have been. When I finally watched the video it was absolutely not a normal campaign video. **Donald Trump included a promise of “the creation of a Unified Reich”.** _If I hadn’t seen it with my own eyes I’m not sure I would have believed it._ The history books warned us about a man like this. We have a potential future President openly promising to make our country into Nazi Germany. Trump now is saying he didn’t see the video but I don’t believe it. We know this guy is on social media all day long, he sees everything his campaign puts out. _I’m begging you: please do not normalize this._ Every single time Trump threatens our democracy we have to call it out. clean_body: Please read this full message Fellow American, The New York Times wrote a story filled with frivolous lies about my childhood. If it weren't so demeaning to my parents' lifelong teaching careers and the town I'm so proud to have been raised in, it might be funny. The simple fact is The New York Times is lying. Here's the truth: and I hope you will read all the way to the end. Growing up, we lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg State University) at only 34 years old. It's incredible to me that this New York Times reporter somehow thinks this fact makes my dad "politically connected." Does she know I 'm running against a career politician who's been riding his father's political coattails in elected office for three decades? I knew getting into this race could mean things would get nasty, but it's sad to see we've fallen so far that one of our nation's oldest papers of record is pushing the Democrats' baked narrative. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. It 's a shame this reporter from New York City doesn't want to tell that story. I think it's a pretty great one. I've opened myself and my family up to attacks from the left, and every day feels like a battle. But I'm no stranger to fighting for what is right and if we don 't elect leaders to go to DC to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it! Here's where I need your help, Fellow American. We need to combat these lies from the New York Times with the TRUTH about me. The Democrats are seeing the same polls you and I see. They know Joe Biden and my opponent Bob Casey are in trouble, and they are going to do WHATEVER IT TAKES to try and defeat me. I hate asking for money -- I'm not a career politician, and it's not in my nature -- but I have no choice but to ask if we're going to hit our fundraising goal. Chuck Schumer and his allies are working overtime to obliterate my campaign. They have committed to spend whatever it takes to defeat me. Friend — **I just got some HUGE news, and I had to make sure you were the first to hear:**
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85388547/474608974/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1268-ot-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiM2NjNjVlMWYtZDMxNy1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=FjWBfcPCaatTIvzOXAc6SDEXW-NRtrEyVIWisxRnmko=)

**Planned Parenthood Action Fund has _officially_ endorsed my campaign for Senate here in Florida! **
I couldn't be prouder of all we've accomplished to gain their support, because right now, the stakes for the future of reproductive rights — both in Florida, and nationwide — have never been higher.
Even before _R_ _oe v. Wade_ was undone, GOP extremists here were laser-focused on rolling back key protections that millions of women in Florida (and across the southeast) were once afforded in our state constitution — **all starting under the governorship of my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott.**
As soon as the _Dobbs_ ruling was settled, we were stuck playing defense. With anti-choice Republicans holding our legislature, state Supreme Court, and the Governor's Mansion hostage, a 15-week trigger ban had already been signed.
**_Dobbs_ just gave them the greenlight to do their worst, and the security to think they could get away with it and more.**
Soon after, those same emboldened authoritarians passed a six-week ban — one of the strictest in the nation — which took effect earlier this month. But little did they know:**The tides in Florida were turning.**
**And across the Sunshine State, pro-choice advocates like you and I came together to let them know that** **_enough is enough. _**
And much to Rick Scott's dismay, we wouldn't be so easily stopped. As soon as that first 15-week ban passed, we took to the streets, gathering nearly a million signatures to put the right to choose on the ballot. When far-right leaders tried to block our ballot measure movement, we took the fight to the Florida Supreme Court.
And even when the court let both devastating bans take effect, they also gave the people of Florida the power to settle this debate once and for all come Election Day.
So I'm sure that if our grassroots movement can keep up the momentum we've built, we've got what it takes to win both of these battles.
Because I'm not just running to retire an anti-choice authoritarian like Rick Scott — I'm running to bring the fight for our rights back to the national stage.
I'm running to build a statewide movement of pro-choice voters here on the frontlines in Florida, who will show up at the polls to take back the rights that Republicans in power have tried so hard to steal from us.
**And no matter what happens, I vow to keep fighting until reproductive rights are enjoyed by every Floridian, and every American, once more.**
That's why I'm overjoyed that our movement has earned Planned Parenthood Action Fund's support in my race to flip Florida's Senate seat blue**. Nothing we've accomplished so far, and nothing we will, would be possible without grassroots supporters like you — thank you.**
And friend, if we stick together, I know we'll win.
Thanks for reading,

Debbie
|

body:
There’s something happening in Missouri I think you should know about.
#
Successful campaigns are all driven by priority, Peter.
There are internal priorities that we handle ourselves every day, like the budget. And then there are everyone else’s priorities — the ones we can’t control, but could very well determine the outcome of this election.
So before I ask you to **[join our grassroots movement to defeat Josh Hawley and elect Lucas Kunce this year,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50965?refcode=em20240521-5577&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5577%2E614464%2E2pMh1A) please let me tell you more about the situation we have going on in Missouri.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50965?refcode=em20240521-5577&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5577%2E614464%2E2pMh1A)**
**Going into this election cycle, GOP insiders knew Josh Hawley was vulnerable.** He was coming down from his stunt on January 6th, which rocked his approval ratings, fundraising, and in-state support base so much that several of his former mentors and mega-donors publicly abandoned his campaign.
But that wasn’t the only reason. Since Hawley’s last election, Missourians have voted overwhelmingly to take back their power by approving ballot measures to raise the minimum wage (2018), expand healthcare (2020), and legalize weed (2022) — signaling a clear break from the control-obsessed politicians like Hawley who’ve taken it upon themselves to rule over our lives.
**With all this information, those GOP insiders decided to make Missouri’s U.S. Senate race their top defensive target in 2024.** They knew Hawley was weak running against a real warrior for working people like Lucas Kunce, so they’ve prioritized our race — doing, saying, and spending whatever it takes to prop up Hawley and tear Lucas down before voters head to the polls this November.
We’ve seen it since _literally_ the first day of this race, when they called Lucas “unhinged” for wanting to take on a coward like Hawley. And we’ve seen it every quarter since, as they transferred millions directly into Hawley’s campaign.
**They know just as well as we do — Hawley is vulnerable, and this election is our opportunity to defeat him and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50965?refcode=em20240521-5577&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5577%2E614464%2E2pMh1A)**
Now here’s where things get complicated. **With so many incumbents in tough races across the country this cycle, Missouri just hasn’t been a priority for the groups we’d typically see shoring up support for campaigns like ours.**
That’s why we need your help, Peter. If enough people like you decide to prioritize our race here in Missouri — which data shows is our most competitive and affordable chance to flip a GOP-held U.S. Senate seat — we’ll be able to pull this off, defeat Josh Hawley, and elect Lucas Kunce this November.
I’m not kidding. Missouri has a smaller electorate and cheaper media markets than other states with targeted flip opportunities, like Texas and Florida. And multiple polls have already shown Lucas and Hawley in a _statistical tie_ for this Senate seat.
Your donation will stretch the furthest in Missouri — and it’ll have more of a direct impact on the outcome of this election. That’s just the truth.
**We need you to make Missouri’s U.S. Senate race a priority, Peter.**
**So now I’m going to ask:[will you chip in $10 or just whatever feels right to you today so we can take advantage of this opportunity to flip a U.S. Senate seat and put Missouri on the map in 2024? Lucas isn’t taking any money from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs in this race, so we mean it when we say that anything you can give makes a big impact.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/50965?refcode=em20240521-5577&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5577%2E614464%2E2pMh1A)**

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: NEW SENATE POLL: Dead-heat in Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend,

We just got new polling on the race for U.S. Senate here in Michigan, and I wanted to make sure you saw it. Bottom line: We are in a statistical dead-heat against one of the leading Republicans, Mike Rogers — with a ton of Michigan swing voters still undecided. Elissa Slotkin: 39.8%
Mike Rogers: 36.8%
Undecided: 23.3% Polling is a notoriously fickle science, especially since it’s still early, but this data underscores a fundamental truth: Michigan is a swing state, and swing states have a tendency to...swing. Despite Democrats’ success in recent years, we know it can flip red under the right conditions.

So in light of this new poll, I want to ask if you’ll consider making a $10 contribution to my campaign.

$10, because we are in a statistical tie against a Trump-endorsed candidate.

Fellow Conservative,

I won’t beat around the bush today—I need your financial support. My primary is two weeks from today, and we’re running dangerously low on critical campaign dollars that we’ll need to ensure we can reach every eligible voter before Election Day. Not only are we running low on campaign funds less than six months before the general election, but we’re being outraised 3-1, sometimes even 5-1.

As I’ve written before, this election will be the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history on a per-vote basis.

In our morning check-in, my finance director informed me that _**we need to raise at least $10,000 from this email today to hit our goal this week.**_**->**

body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-edtude-tlidtddjku-x/) Team Carris,The situation in Israel continues to fall prey to the partisan divide in Congress. Last week marked Israeli Independence Day and for many Jewish families around the world, commemorations looked and felt very different - marked by solemnity and concern but hopeful and united. The torch-lighting ceremony at Mount Herzl that aired Monday night marked a bleak 76th Independence Day, the first since Hamas's October 7 attack on Israel.The current administration and many in Congress claim to support Israel but they continue to betray the US-Israel alliance by withholding US military resources vital to Israel's self-defense. House Republicans in Congress and 16 Democrats stepped up to try and stop these actions and block the administration from this travesty. I applaud those members on both sides of the aisle that came together to pass this vital legislation.Meanwhile, Brad Schneider, the current 10th Congressional District Representative, supports Joe Biden in withholding the aid package for Israel. He stands with the far left in blocking the U.S. from helping our strongest ally in the Middle East, and securing the region against the persistent threat of Hamas and Iran's proxies.During a recent telephone Town Hall held by Representative Schneider, he stated that President Biden has stood with Israel longer during a time of war than any other president in our history and that legislation introduced by House Republicans is bad, dangerous, and just a message bill where Republicans are using Israel as a wedge issue to create a divide in Congress. The irony is that it's President Biden who is creating the partisan political division over the Israel crisis. **With bipartisan agreement to send aid coming out of Congress, our President took it upon himself to defy the wishes of our citizens and elected representatives by endeavoring to withhold what was agreed upon military aid**. And, Brad Schneider is standing with him on blocking that aid to Israel.Representative Schneider not only outspokenly defends the President but he also voted against reversing President Biden's hold on sending vital weapons to Israel, putting party allegiance over national security and our ally. His continual references to the Republicans and specific members of Congress deflects the blame from himself and every other Democrat who voted against this bill and distracts from the real issue at hand - **supporting Israel**.As I wrote this week and shared with our community on social media, I believe the hostages need to be returned, Israel needs to be armed, and Hamas needs to be defeated. Not in the future, but today. I will continue to advocate loudly for this in the public forum. Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress National Police Week 2024 We also celebrated National Police Week 2024 last week. Wearing a badge, risking your life for your community, and enforcing our laws has never been more dangerous. According to the National Fraternal Order of Police (FOP), the number of police officers shot on the job hit a new high in 2023. 378 officers were shot in the line of duty last year which is up 14% from the 330 shot in 2022. Of the 378 officers shot, 46 were killed.Not only are they faced with threats of violence and ambush on the job and off duty, our elected officials are actively working against our law enforcement officers rather than standing behind them in support. In 2017, Representative Schneider voted against making the killing or attempting to kill a law enforcement officer an aggravating factor in determining whether to impose the death penalty.To celebrate this week and to continue to advocate for police across Illinois and our nation, I will continue to watch the [Protect and Serve Act](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-r/), which creates federal criminal penalties for those who target police officers and other legislation that benefits our men and women in blue. [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-y/) **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Tuning Into Big Ideas at the Big Event**
I attended the Lake County Partners' Big Event and met many wonderful constituents. Under the incredible leadership of Kevin Considine, LCP is the go-to organization for economic development in Lake County. As a business person, I will advocate for businesses to move into and expand in #IL10. Under the current administration, businesses are under an onslaught of high taxes and regulations. When I get to Congress, I will work to reduce taxes and regulations on businesses in our District so that they can thrive. 🇺🇸 **Sharing Support for a Great Cause with Local Police Men and Women**
I visited the Highland Park Dunkin' Donuts as well as other locations in support of the annual Cop on a Rooftop Dunkin' Donuts event which raises money for the athletes of Special Olympics Illinois. With 18,912 athletes with intellectual disabilities, the Special Olympics does such great work for our communities, friends and families with special needs. 🇺🇸 **Celebrating a The Salvation Army Together**
I attended this year's Salvation Army Annual Civic Luncheon yesterday in celebration of their many wonderful programs and services. This international organization does such great work around taking care of the human needs of all people without discrimination. It's a Christian based organization that does tremendous work for everyone. I was proud to be there to celebrate with everyone! The VFW and TAL start the Parade at Grayslake Community High School and conclude the parade at Grayslake's Memorial Park, which is at the junction of Seymour and Junior Ave in the historical homes area of downtown Grayslake. **Event Information**

We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-t/) **Check Out Our Summer Internship Opportunities**
Calling all students and recent grads! Are you looking to join a dynamic team of volunteers this summer to work on a congressional campaign? Apply today to join Team Carris for a summer internship. As a Team Carris Intern, you will get experience working on a congressional campaign and learn the inner-workings of the campaign world. The program is open to high school students, college students, and recent graduates - no prior campaign experience is required. [Click Here to Apply](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-i/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** **Post of the Week:** Head over to my social media channels to commemorate various celebrations including Mother's Day! Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-d/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-h/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-edtude-tlidtddjku-k/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! name: Hillsdale College via Pro Life Update
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zecon4b08ic9f8sg2n87jm9lbmkissg4sujher08_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjm8p34c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z76h6amsjetsne2s4n5sf59gmkc4djf0lg9pjkag_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjm8p34c1h2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zo29rbrckb340k8t33atjk186i0jj319f7fietr0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjm8p34c1h2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Susheela Jayapal for Congress
body:
https://www.mobilize.us/susheelajayapalforcongress/event/628421/ [https://www.mobilize.us/susheelajayapalforcongress/event/628421/]
https://www.mobilize.us/susheelajayapalforcongress/event/628421/ [https://www.mobilize.us/susheelajayapalforcongress/event/628421/]
I just called and extended my congratulations to Maxine Dexter on her election to represent Oregon’s Third Congressional District.
I am so proud of the campaign that I and my supporters ran. We were clear, from the beginning, that we were going to run a campaign based on values, and on our vision for the country and the district.
Values of integrity, commitment, and justice. A vision of a country and a district that truly honors and serves all of our communities. In which we are all equal, and all deserving.
That vision is what I have spent the last several decades of my life working for: on the board of Planned Parenthood, fighting for reproductive rights; ensuring that frontline workers got better wages for their heroic work; holding fossil fuel companies accountable for destructive climate change; and always advocating for resources for those who have been left out and left behind. This work is why over 100 local community leaders– who I have been so proud to work with–endorsed my campaign.
I am so proud of running a campaign in which people who have never before felt included, did. A campaign In which those who have felt on the margins, weren’t just at the table - were running the table. A campaign powered by over 5600 donations, most of whom were grassroots donors who contributed what they had to help me raise over $1 million - and we did it the hard way, with donors by and large from this district.
This race showed so clearly why we need to have real campaign finance reform that allows for public financing. Outside super PACs came in and spent an unprecedented $6 million, even timing their contributions so that they wouldn’t have to show who was trying to buy this election until well after the votes were cast. While we weren’t able to change that fact this time around, I remain committed to working to make our elections truly democratic.

body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb3cquta0ksuqpamvtvn8u4qe89o7ere0pb4qoi8_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmco71chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsh38r3q8fjek1s4sjeiffrh91hiuq7s088h8sgo_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmco71chh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7nfpibpmlovac4d6urgmtk4e100a0peloidasgo_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmco71chh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

# TESTIMONY
Can I share a profound testimony that has rocked our world and brought immense joy to my heart? My beloved wife, Nena, has been wrestling with relentless health challenges, including a fierce battle with cancer. In October 2020, we received the devastating news that she had six months to live. We pursued every method outside of chemotherapy. We had some success with alternative treatments, but it was at a cost of $6,000 a month, and we just could not afford it anymore. But today, seven weeks ago, a monumental shift occurred in our lives. Nena underwent stem cell therapy, and the transformation has been nothing short of miraculous. Let me paint a picture of this incredible journey: Firstly, her insulin levels plummeted by a staggering 75%. Now, Nena has been reliant on insulin since childhood, making this a profound and life-changing development. Secondly, her vision, once clouded and aided by bifocals, has been restored to a sharp 20/20. Wrinkles have vanished, and her hair has reclaimed its natural color. Her hemoglobin levels, previously alarmingly low, have shown marked improvement. And most significantly, her cancer has regressed to stage 1 from stage 4. This, my friends, is undeniably a God-sized miracle. We are bursting with gratitude and a deep desire to share this miracle with all of you, our cherished friends and family. On the 23rd of this month, my dear friend Pastor James Fortune will share his wisdom in another enlightening seminar on stem cell therapy. Stem cell therapy isn't just a hope or a promise; it's a reality that has yielded remarkable results across various ailments. From cancer to thyroid issues, weight management to hair regrowth, chemical imbalances to hormone problems, and even autism, stem cell therapy has shown incredible promise of hope. And I assure you, this isn't about a high-pressure sales pitch. We want you to join us, to learn, to share in our joy, and to enjoy a complimentary dinner as a token of our appreciation. If this resonates with you and you seek hope and healing, please fill out the form using the link provided. I promise you an evening of enlightenment, community, and, above all, hope. Together, let's embrace the possibilities of a brighter, healthier tomorrow. Thank you. PS. If you are not in driving distance to LA and you are interested we can come and do a seminar for you in your area. We will even pick up the tab. You will not regret this. If this is of interest to you please email me at officialderrickgates@gmail.com Love you all Derrick Gates You can also watch Nena talk about her Testimony with Pastor James Fortune Below,

subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zh8o6799am8nfnikeanqbo5736pvkagdhnjvt1n8_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmaor5cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvo1n5jdq8bji4508v5gr3lp5nl7fm7bb1i6ns3g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmaor5cph2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:

opened this letter because you remember my playing days with the
Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having
you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey
Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we
battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...

...well,
as they say, "Those were the days."

But this
email - isn't about baseball in fact, it's an email I never
thought I'd be writing to you.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a
seat in the United States Senate.

Today,
I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that
folks will be talking about for generations to come.

Because
when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s
weren't as good as we tend to first remember.

Baseball
was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that
had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy
after another.

I'm
running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is
starting to look a lot like 1970s America.

You
remember what it was like:

►
Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we
could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license
plate numbers. Remember?

►
Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village
in Munich by terrorists. Remember?

►
Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists
in Iran. Remember?

Democrat
policies had brought America to its knees.

And now,
as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's deja vu all over again."

There's
fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime,
homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding
and for the first time causing more people to leave California.

Joe
Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one
bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to
say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and
dependent.

And I
wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best
days are behind us."

But
listen, here's something I also want you to remember...

We
Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic
malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.

We put
classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.

And
America became a shining city upon a hill once more.

We can do
that again.

It starts
by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.

But
there's no way I can pull it off without you.

That's
why I'm asking you to rush back your Garvey for Senate
contribution of $35 or more right away.

I'm sorry
for the urgency but Election Day is just six months away...

And in
that time, we need to build a 58-county, grassroots campaign
capable of defeating Adam Schiff who has ActBlue allies and a war
chest he's assembled during his two decades in Washington, D.C.

That may
seem daunting, but I know with your help, I can beat him in
November.

Why?

First...
I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can
tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've
never seen before.

They are
hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters
in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of
California...

I know we
can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.

Second...
you know I'm not a career politician.

But I do
have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in
California...

…name recognition.

I'm no
Schwarzenegger and I'd certainly never dare compare myself to
President Reagan.

But
California voters know me.

And Adam
Schiff and the Democrats are shaking in their boots seeing how
quickly I rose in the polls after entering the race.

As I'm
writing you this letter, there are just a few percentage points
separating us.

We've got
a shot -- a very real shot -- in the general election. But we
only have six months. And the giant Democrat political machine
is going to use every second of that time trying to bury me and
our common sense message.

When you
rush your Garvey for Senate campaign contribution of $35 or
more...

...you're
helping fund ads, appearances, events, fliers, door knockers,
EVERYTHING that blankets California with the message:

You don't
have to accept failed Democrat policies that make all of us less
safe, less prosperous, and less free.

This race
is the toughest in the nation.

But they
say the hardest thing to do in sports is hit a 95-mph fastball.

And you
know I've done that plenty of times.

Now I'm
ready to do the hardest thing in American politics -- win in
California as a common sense Republican.

But I
can't do it without you.

When we
win here... when we rip this seat out of the hands of the radical
Adam Schiff...

...we
start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country
desperately needs.

It all
depends on the choice you make in the next 48 hours.

You can
do nothing and continue to suffer the agony of defeat. Or you can
step up to the plate with me and take a swing for the thrill of
victory. Please join me. Because when we win in California, we're
winning for all of America.

Thank you
and God Bless,

Steve
Garvey #6

P.S. It's
the bottom of the 9th and Republicans desperately need a homerun.
We simply can't let another election slip through our fingers
while Democrats go on destroying our country. With your help, I
know we can beat Adam Schiff in California and start the
Republican Comeback Rally America needs. But Election Day is just
six months away. So please rush back your Garvey for Senate
campaign contribution of $35 or more as soon as you can. Thank
you!
--Steve

PAID FOR
BY STEVE GARVEY FOR U.S. SENATE

532389
Los
Angeles, CA 90053-2389

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zl42dd2vealuh3mmp36nli4vi3bhumjbcu57c368_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmeob2clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zm8v2th4rm8eoopojl3cdeq28v725854i0hmv3lo_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmeob2clh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ze5jm00a05o0go1giju2dqdn06qo2m7b8898q1og_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cpjmeob2clh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. ## Turbulent Flight Kills 1, Injures 70
Severe turbulence on a Singapore Airlines flight from London to Singapore left [one passenger dead and 71 injured](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuxCAQRb8Gd1gwfhcUadxt2pQWj8GeFQsrYNfJ30dOne5KVzpHOl-37aYpUNw_9QNV9WnTttIbt4EDcOi3vnHKIwJ2DSo5ybGbpRjm5lC2M52zxi5idJP1EoR08zItkwCDgzcNKRDQiwFAzMMoZetnb_SCUi5j72Q3sl6go5pye08U64E-_KQ35tamRxPUUeuzsO6DwcpgPc-z1d-UyvUyWC82g1UM15YM1kJx18-UkWvKgSIWXl_ZvAJGi9wH2o_KHep6cIr3VyYsTVbueVIIVMaJ9WJ_aAp_9vpvi98AAAD__zWtYEw), some severely, after the plane fell nearly 6,000 feet in minutes. Airline officials said it was likely the 73-year-old British man who died had a heart condition. At least six other passengers were hospitalized in Thailand, where the plane made an emergency landing. [Here are photos of the plane's interior posted to X.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjztu6zAQAE9Ddja4y3_B4jXq_NqUAm0uLQaUaEgbG7l9kKRNN8AUg3m7zJfcetvu__NKieuY843bk2Z7QjyhmY0sqRIhaUkJPDgdQNkgl-SCi4WKjVcbyGny0QKijto7MhWusiVUaJRFVME6gHMN9ZojAURnCmgnjKLSeOzn99E2Xqj2z_Gk_Xwbq-xpYX4cQv8TOAmc-NWYf53AyduDbmMrdAicDs788Q3gI0YNBi2AMmh98HJP5fFqvbfDeWHUfc2t_wT4z92vAAAA___esFLJ) The Boeing 777-300ER was cruising at 37,000 feet when it hit "sudden extreme turbulence," launching any passengers who weren't wearing seat belts into the ceiling, with [some heads denting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGuozAQAL_GdEbetTFQUFxDl2uvRAYvsIljR7YTdH9_ytWvG2ma0fy5LTfHgePx2z1pqnta3Fb5Q0snESWaxTR-2omQdEMT9GD1AKobmnPSqjej0wBut92ooBuN0p3tASx6T7bhCRUa1SGqobMA7T7sqxsJYLTGg7bCKPJcU27viWM9aQ9_04dyu6VnE6az1lcR-pfAWeB8XVe7rSXSVb5e4PxFgXPheLhXyiQd58CRiiz0oUyyvvP6DhQ3knvg46xSI8iQok9RenL1lBzv70xFri4ej_SQwUXP8RA4N3nyr4tD4GJ7YdTxdBz-l9UfP_0LAAD__znbawY) or breaking the overhead cabins.
## Nestle Targets Weight-Loss Drugs
Nestle, the world's biggest food company, is launching a new line of frozen [pizza and pasta dishes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2SpCAUQOGnwQxKLj-tAcEmZr3phhbCpb07CJYybXU__dRMPPFJTn3_7vPdU6by-Os3dC3V2YdGT5wNB-CgZ91FlxABVYdO3qRVg-zN0K0uBBXHgJi80osHY8ISxhEAdUwqptSRgx50bwD6wVgpRRrS4keUcrQ6SmWZ7jFSq4f4X6m0FVN-1SceItSty25tbT-Z-sNgYjBd1yWoRNyxRCxNhCo-PxhMmRLys70yMphSrZH7Enk8qHzXCx_1-eL1jdtOgRc8W0a-0_vteSRsfAGjB2tHsbYtd4eL-0U502lvTPePzVP-uWm_2nwFAAD__zIZZ9g) aimed specifically at customers who take popular weight-loss drugs such as Wegovy or Ozempic. The company said it was adding more protein, fiber, iron, and calcium and shrinking the portions of the new food line to provide "food solutions" for people who no longer have much of an appetite to eat at all. The drugs' effectiveness in killing appetite has worried food retailers who fear sales will fall. Nestle's 12 new targeted food products, [including whole grain bowls and sandwich melts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GO6yAURL8GOizuNQZSULwmXV67pWXDxWaFQxRQUPbrV0691Yw0Ix2dr9t8W1JO9-3_cpBrscyLb-lF8yQQBapZ8eAiEdLIyYEBPVqQk-W7m8BKDCsaD6sFr8mDWaMCZfQYTESeHEpUckKUdtIAQ7RxXS4EcNEqwKiZkhRSK8_hu6R72ynmd3nRc_Dl4NntrT0qG_8xvDK89t4Hv9Y79XruDK9n_URtmUQsJYhOW3m9Rfmh45G86JS2vYlc6nnkTxcePeWcqjZMye1YUv6w2p_mvwEAAP__3Nta5w), are expected to hit stores nationwide toward the end of the year.

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please participate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jHKQwlCuMvga982v6FaDKw~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jHKQwlCuMvga982v6FaDKw~~/AARclAA~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/jHKQwlCuMvga982v6FaDKw~~/AARclAA~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lD3Ioc29tKLGGwSTFYMUVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoMFgeP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDUyMlcDc3BjQgpmRsG_TWY0Lz-tUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lD3Ioc29tKLGGwSTFYMUVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoMFgeP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDUyMlcDc3BjQgpmRsG_TWY0Lz-tUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/lD3Ioc29tKLGGwSTFYMUVA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoMFgeP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLVJPTi0yMDI0MDUyMlcDc3BjQgpmRsG_TWY0Lz-tUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

Restore Our Nation

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te2644896-abae-46b8-8ba8-acba4490a4a0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | | | Peter, I have served this country my entire life. Now that I’ve retired from the US Army as a Brigadier General, I’m ready to continue my service in a new arena. I live in the Georgia district currently represented by Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think my neighbors deserve better. Over the course of 40 years in the armed forces, I served our country in various capacities, including as an infantry commander in Afghanistan following the tragic events of 9/11. I ultimately worked as a senior military advisor at military posts around the world. That means I was providing strategic guidance and leadership to keep our nation strong against foreign adversaries. I took an oath to protect the US Constitution from all enemies, foreign AND domestic. When I left the Army to start my farm here in North Georgia, I discovered that my country still needed me. The current US Congress is the weakest, most chaotic legislature in my memory, and my district is right at the heart of it. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0384ddfe-b8fd-4ee9-b4be-35468b6e0b5d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I think Georgia deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. I think America deserves better than Marjorie Taylor Greene. My background on both the enlisted and officer side of the armed forces has prepared me to address the complex challenges facing our nation today. That starts with core American values we are severely lacking from some of our elected officials today.

| I’m taking on MTG so we can bring sanity back to Washington. We don’t need chaos and childish tantrums from our elected officials, we need basic, steady leadership. I find that the people I talk to mostly agree: we need better, we deserve better, and it’s time to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene with someone focused on what’s best for America rather than what’s best for herself. [**If you also agree that MTG needs to be defeated, I’m asking for your help.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3d0154ee-16cb-4f8b-801d-8739ed5a7bdc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsixKysWvN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osixKysWvN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Friend,
C.S.
Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions
through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to
read.

His
signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has
inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more
believers to renew and deepen their faith-making him the greatest
Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's
why we produced "C.S. Lewis on Christianity," which you can now
own on DVD.

In this
course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central
topics of Christianity, including:

good
and evil,

conversion and faith,

prayer and the Bible,

suffering and death,

heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward
is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a
member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University
of Oxford. He is the author of Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens
in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis and After Humanity: A Guide to
C.S. Lewis's The Abolition of Man, and the co-editor of The
Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis. He even spent three years
living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The
Kilns!

This
course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's
beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey
from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity
for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of
Christianity.

That's
why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of
Christianity with C.S. Lewis with this beautiful DVD box set.

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College
