WASHINGTON, D.C. is completely dysfunctional. Out-of-touch politicians have proven themselves incapable of solving (or even understanding) our country's problems. I recently announced that I am running for Congress in New Hampshire's Second Congressional District for one reason: We need leaders with real world experience who can fix this mess.
I am the son of immigrants who sought freedom and opportunity in the United States. I have lived the American Dream, going from pumping gas at my father's gas station to serving in the boardrooms of some of the largest companies in the world. My business career has taken me to more than 75 countries, and my travels have made it clear that America is still that shining city on a hill that drew my parents here decades ago.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c67c9842-202c-458d-97b5-7c240e0dc32f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But it's obvious that something's not quite right. Rampant inflation. Open borders. Surging crime. And anti-Americanism and antisemitism are spreading across our campuses. Our children and grandchildren are going to inherit an America that isn't as free or prosperous as the one our parents and grandparents left us. They'll inherit one in which patriotism has been replaced with defeatist beliefs about an increasingly less perfect union.
Identifying the cause of the problem isn't very hard: Washington, D.C. is filled with career politicians who spend their lives running for office and career bureaucrats bouncing from one government job to another. Having spent their lives in the D.C. bubble, they are completely detached from the lives of ordinary Americans. They don't want to solve our problems; they think we are the problem.
If you want an example, look no further than the economy. Inflation remains out of control and a recession looms. Again, the problem is obvious. The politicians and bureaucrats printed, borrowed, and spent too much money. If any of them had ever spent some time running a business, they would understand basic economics and have known inflation would follow.
[Learn More About Vikram's Campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/347bdc83-2e58-410f-8c69-e562c753932f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Worse, they deny there is even a problem. The economy is doing great, they insist, exasperated; they assume you just don't understand. Sure, the economy is great, _for them_. As a matter of fact, some of the wealthiest zip codes in the country are in the D.C. area. Meanwhile, ordinary Americans everywhere are suffering from a rising cost of living that's pinching budgets. One parent I recently met talked about the difficulty of explaining to her kids that she couldn't afford summer camp for them this year.
Enough is enough. We need to live within our means. Yes, that means tough choices, but don't we all do that with our monthly budgets? We need accountability and we need to stop handing out blank checks. We need more people in Congress who have signed the front of a paycheck as well as the back.
Our open borders are another sign Washington, D.C. is broken. The uncontrolled flow of people and drugs across our borders is a national security disaster and it is wreaking havoc in our neighborhoods. As the son of legal immigrants, I wholeheartedly believe immigration is good for our country. I support a "Tall Wall and a Wide Gate" -- a secure border and a welcoming _legal_ immigration system. But our leaders continue to ignore the problem as the situation worsens. Shockingly, they cannot even bring themselves to say the word "illegal" to describe the rampant law-breaking behavior.
It is clear that our leaders in Washington have also made a mess of the wider world. The disastrous Afghanistan withdrawal telegraphed weakness, and soon our enemies were advancing on multiple fronts. Russia invaded Ukraine. Hamas and Iran attacked Israel. And China is now salivating at the prospect of "reintegrating" Taiwan and Venezuela is preparing to annex neighboring Guyana's gigantic oil fields.
Politicians and career bureaucrats have forgotten (if they ever knew) that when America is strong, our adversaries take notice; when America is weak, they take advantage.
We don't need to send another career politician or career bureaucrat to Congress who doesn't understand how the world works. We don't need another D.C. insider who is going to go along to get along, checking career boxes in a never-ending quest for ever greater titles. We need a conservative outsider with real world experience who wants to shake things up in D.C. to help the people of New Hampshire. We need someone who can fix this mess, not someone who helped create it.
Despite our country's problems, I am an optimist. It's time to restore American strength at home and abroad, making it crystal clear that the United State remains a land of opportunity for all. It's time to revive the American Dream, assuring that our children and grandchildren have the same opportunities we did. And most importantly, it's time to evict career bureaucrats and politicians and return Washington to a government of, by, and for the people..
_**[Vikram Mansharamani of Lincoln is a Republican candidate for Congress in the 2nd Congressional District.](https://substack.com/redirect/06675818-57f3-4cfd-a56a-cebfbb265d8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

name: Dr. Prasanth Reddy
subject: Today is monumental
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY REDDY FOR KANSAS
body:
| | | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/531a5242d91e057a3947229f28c3afba/3833b4825ab88b29c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
| | Later today, I’m going to Topeka to officially file to appear on the ballot as a Republican for Kansas’ 3rd District.

Ahead of then, our team has set a goal of 300 online donations.**[Will you chip in $24, or even just $4, now?](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/531a5242d91e057a3947229f28c3afba/09d449064ce62aaac3d6b838967d376c/43823)**
---
[**DONATE NOW **](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/531a5242d91e057a3947229f28c3afba/b47289dafc57f605c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
My family came here from India on the promise of the American Dream.

I became a cancer physician. After more than a decade in private practice, I moved to research.

When the unthinkable happened on 9/11, I saw a chance to give back to the country that had given me so much. I enlisted in the Air Force Reserve, and still serve today as a Lt. Colonel.

Running for office was never part of my plan. But I can’t sit back any longer while career politicians undo what’s made America exceptional.

**[As an outsider to this process, I mean it when I say that this campaign depends on emails like this one. So I hope you’ll pitch in before I file later today.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/531a5242d91e057a3947229f28c3afba/6002c3ef154c17a8c3d6b838967d376c/43823)**
---
[**DONATE NOW **](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/531a5242d91e057a3947229f28c3afba/a59f7d1a41df7edcc3d6b838967d376c/43823)
---
I’m an outsider. I can’t say the same for Sharice Davids, the Democrat who holds this seat today.

She’s beholden to the party bosses. She votes with Joe Biden nearly 100% of the time. She ignores the issues the voters are most concerned about.

**And her party’s machine is going all-in to defeat me — they’ve already made an $800,000 ad buy! **

This is one of the most competitive House races in the country, and we have the winning message. But we can’t get outspent 10:1, which is why we’re setting a big fundraising goal of 300 online donations today.

The stakes couldn’t be higher. If you haven’t given in a while, now’s the time. If you’ve been waiting to give, I hope you won’t wait any longer.

[**Let’s flip this House seat, and let’s send a physician and military officer to do things differently in Congress.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/531a5242d91e057a3947229f28c3afba/f2aad658fe281c26c3d6b838967d376c/43823)
Thank you.

name: Angela Alsobrooks
subject: it would be my honor to serve Maryland in the U.S. Senate, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25324?t=1014&amount=25&akid=1700%2E52803%2ESK4WYe ][IMG]

Hi Peter, Angela Alsobrooks here! I’m a lifelong Marylander,
mom, former elected prosecutor, and County Executive of Prince George’s
County, and now...

I’m the Democratic nominee to be Maryland’s next United States Senator!

Before I tell you all about why I decided to run, I want to make you a
simple promise: I will always take the time to learn from and listen to
you. I’ll work diligently every single day to make this community proud.

The truth is, there aren’t enough people in the Senate who live and think
like the people they were elected to represent. I know the people of
Maryland should have a Senator who not only fights for them, but who also
understands and shares their concerns.

The journey we’re on is an investment in a better tomorrow, for Maryland
and for our country. I can’t tell you how grateful I am that you’re by my
side, Peter.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25324?t=1015&amount=15&akid=1700%2E52803%2ESK4WYe ]Your generous support will put us on the best possible footing for the
road ahead. If you can, will you invest $15, $25, or any amount in our
campaign for the U.S. Senate?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25324?t=1016&express_lane=true&amount=25&akid=1700%2E52803%2ESK4WYe ]Chip in $25 [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25324?t=1017&express_lane=true&amount=50&akid=1700%2E52803%2ESK4WYe ]Chip in $50

Each time I’ve run for office, it’s because I recognized a problem that I
had the right tools to fix.

That’s the outlook handed down to me by my great-grandmother, Maebell
James. She was the strongest woman I’ve ever met. She prevailed over
cruelty and injustice in her life with inexhaustible dignity.

She had one rule for her family: No complaints.

She’d often say, “If you don't like something, you go farther and you do
better.”

That lesson lived on through my hard-working parents. They taught me what
integrity looks like and to respect all work.

Their example led me to run for office for the first time 14 years ago,
right here in Prince George’s County. I fought to develop new economic
opportunities, improve the health, safety, and security of our
communities, and strengthen our education system.

I’m deeply proud of the things we’ve accomplished so far — But in
Washington, there’s plenty of work left to do. With a little determination
and a good attitude, I know we can go farther and do better for all
Marylanders.

There will be bumps on the journey ahead. But as I write this, there’s not
a doubt in my mind that we’ll overcome them together.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25324?t=1007&amount=25&akid=1700%2E52803%2ESK4WYe ]Peter, if you can, will you chip in $25 to our historic
campaign? I can’t tell you just how much I value your support.

Angela Alsobrooks

Curtis Bashaw
Entrepreneur. Husband. Preservationist.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He’s running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

She serves as the Executive Director of [Future Coalition](https://substack.com/redirect/377e01d4-44e3-4556-a341-aeb5b07eb135?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an organization whose mission is to provide young change makers with the resources they need to propel transformational change. We discuss:
* Empowering the youth to save us (from ourselves)
* The role of racial justice in our nation's progress
* How to stay engaged in politics even if we disagree with what the Party may be doing

And they have every right to say NO to it. The vote is set for the company's annual meeting on June 13th, so we need to act now to build momentum against the move. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May’s season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore’s most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis’ company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island’s East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Hi Friend,
Brace yourself...because you may end up throwing out a lot of the food in your fridge after you finish reading today’s email.
You see, Maryland physician Dr. Brian Paris says many so-called "health foods" are actually the cause of sore, stiff joints that make you feel miserable.
_"If you’re in constant, chronic, excruciating agony and don't feel well, it has to do with what you’re eating...and just as important...what you’re not eating but should eat,"_ says Dr. Paris.
Dr. Paris found certain foods marketed as being healthy...
...actually contain a toxic nutrient your immune system sees as the enemy.
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8jjFvgzAUhH_NYwuyz2DDwJAW0aFS906RY5vEKQZinKL8-woUdby7T-99OsyD758NqTcCrt4uBJA4EnD_XkN83MLnx0GxeDzc5VcotxXvBKTn7P7R15XcBe2HrVVtZhvRW1ZkruGKS1HJWrHs2nBIXktzLs9QvalL5WrAVdZJIRR6kfkGDAUrAV6wGiJnMPaMuiil1s7yngq2_8l1cNEbzZe06hinKeRmCtnQXFOal12sI3Rm-MkH_-tm7cc-OrdBhI6zigtCJ6sNE90jhZPRYdb-MpJodb_GUwmgIMh9m8bkxkSivU1-TMurDs76RyDRvnJycUtZbOy8-mHwi1RUsMsubKbwFwAA__9WYnAe) So, every time you take a bite of one of these foods... your immune system unleashes its "army" to attack this nutrient.
And since this nutrient enters your bloodstream once it’s digested...your immune system starts attacking even healthy tissue and organs...**_causing burning in your joints and muscles_**.
Dr. Paris explains, _"Most of my patients assume their joint issues are a normal part of the aging process. They have no idea eating the wrong foods can cause joint problems."_

Hi Peter, Today would be Harvey Milk’s 94th birthday. Serving on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, he was the first openly gay man to be elected to public office. He embodied staying true to his personal convictions and is a personal hero of mine. Milk stood up for the LGBTQ+ community, sponsoring a bill on the Board of Supervisors that banned discrimination in public housing and stopped employers from discriminating based on sexual orientation. Tragically, he was shot and killed by a disgruntled former City Supervisor shortly after the bill was passed into law. In Wisconsin, Tammy Baldwin has broken many glass ceilings as the first woman elected to serve in the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin and the first openly gay member elected. These stories inspire me because it's personal to me. As a member of the LGBTQ+ community, I will serve with these same convictions, standing up for and protecting LGBTQ+ folks from discrimination. clean_body: I will stand up for the LGBTQ+ community in Congress | | = Hi Peter, Today would be Harvey Milk’s 94th birthday. Serving on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, he was the first openly gay man to be elected to public office. He embodied staying true to his personal convictions and is a personal hero of mine. Milk stood up for the LGBTQ+ community, sponsoring a bill on the Board of Supervisors that banned discrimination in public housing and stopped employers from discriminating based on sexual orientation. Tragically, he was shot and killed by a disgruntled former City Supervisor shortly after the bill was passed into law. In Wisconsin, Tammy Baldwin has broken many glass ceilings as the first woman elected to serve in the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin and the first openly gay member elected. | | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8ceeefa7-8cc4-4b6a-b1c0-1af80dfeecff/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7c803b31-5cf0-4b0e-8894-ad6ca8528baa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Moments before what would’ve been certain death, a fellow soldier put out the fire. By the grace of God, I’m blessed beyond measure to be here right now. I lived that day, and I know that it’s because HE has called me to continue serving my country. **[That’s why, today, I’m running for U.S. Senate in Nevada — the biggest race on the map.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8b222ac239644be49afd3ccaa916b21c&_e=uE5ztk1xcGVroQQ0QfO-Zx5yFYABJYOgKqfdCtteJUiOO87FGFEQO_vDeCNhEfwfhhfbB_YAfQe6T48GbHpy4kjVHAPN2DCy_9vitd20aPDrUZxE9eWOl7yz2YXj8w78CvVjyIENgg4T4KymDHcy9JrIphZxJl3DeGPHcFkL1CFfdfjCiUfelIpj7ViAOIWB3E8NUImw9kRMtIRKIDL1p5VcUgFjsYrNBQ6dKPaHB_ayae2vNLDeTKe1m59PsrPpEt3tfjEqvKI9o2et4ohyNpx3l3NxzaXmzJJYs_TRbpgWN_ME_ASOw8l8QPhug290hcgx9RkY-cuQBlaJhwCW2xWFfCiaPiIULJvaclWLR-0ApDhdr-jAJB4sTnbnfbaPJzla7DHd_tiTAoLKPxj4fSQ4etbo2UKrQzWatMDkIX3RtO9kNskrutkvvGzWofWXQkibTBD5PzLTxIjL3KjxocFrJ-PketZahyPsmykwBj4vfO4QO8xAxO5OCCruqqr1npKHUm2qltDYfwVprgyxe3iHb9sAtZlvUB25lT87Cu8ntqR9rf1SZ98xVTFMexVZ)** If we lose in Nevada, America as we know it is gone. Friend
We can all feel that the country is off track, so I created a plan to be our [GPS](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtazIrLq77ERhEfwm8Z06_vBQgWRt5HdRqgz_0qUDaR1ZPAFZRKdTto1g6ujZF7Nvr6bKzBBhWw-qcgitrjFuwVSXaTIFlztnvMPvDLBqxbE9URR8Umc5VJOadXpdWLo_Jlr9JH8B-lD1L2Ih3T6rZo6ZBSQIrCkPd-uM6BygM3_Tz0tg_65ZQ==&c=h1WVfI9m_Nbs4tH1XAI_329EFBD5_K_gkyiVxuOhJiCwsTUnhR94QQ==&ch=IIqyOJyUAlbJvSOzNTOyoJeD_6B37ZBlBuc4j8jLs-jQXzJwyy-3Xg==). It's easy to be a critic and complain about Washington, but voters deserve to know not only what I see to be the problems but also my positive vision for how to solve those problems in the future.
That's why I've created this GPS plan to be a guide to navigating through Congress if Third District residents choose me as their next representative," explained Hudson. I hope those who review my plan will have a clear understanding of how I seek to serve.
---
| [](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtazIrLq77ERhEfwm8Z06_vBQgWRt5HdRqgz_0qUDaR1ZPAFZRKdTto1g6ujZF7Nvr6bKzBBhWw-qcgitrjFuwVSXaTIFlztnvMPvDLBqxbE9URR8Umc5VJOadXpdWLo_Jlr9JH8B-lD1L2Ih3T6rZo6ZBSQIrCkPd-uM6BygM3_Tz0tg_65ZQ==&c=h1WVfI9m_Nbs4tH1XAI_329EFBD5_K_gkyiVxuOhJiCwsTUnhR94QQ==&ch=IIqyOJyUAlbJvSOzNTOyoJeD_6B37ZBlBuc4j8jLs-jQXzJwyy-3Xg==)
---
|
Under the title "[Common Sense for Crazy Times](https://5hqec7gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XtazIrLq77ERhEfwm8Z06_vBQgWRt5HdRqgz_0qUDaR1ZPAFZRKdTto1g6ujZF7Nvr6bKzBBhWw-qcgitrjFuwVSXaTIFlztnvMPvDLBqxbE9URR8Umc5VJOadXpdWLo_Jlr9JH8B-lD1L2Ih3T6rZo6ZBSQIrCkPd-uM6BygM3_Tz0tg_65ZQ==&c=h1WVfI9m_Nbs4tH1XAI_329EFBD5_K_gkyiVxuOhJiCwsTUnhR94QQ==&ch=IIqyOJyUAlbJvSOzNTOyoJeD_6B37ZBlBuc4j8jLs-jQXzJwyy-3Xg==)," I created the GPS plan to combine broad guiding principles with specific policy solutions under three categories:

* Growth. The economy has gone haywire the past few years as costs have skyrocketed, wages have stagnated, and everyday life has become unaffordable. We will unlock economic growth through free markets, lower taxes, less regulation, and lower government spending.

* Prosperity. There's an old saying that I live by: Let's leave this place a little better than we found it. As a parent, I'm worried that we're not living up to that promise to our children. To ensure the long-term prosperity of our country, we need to get back to the basics of promoting high-quality education, jobs, and healthcare.

* Security. Our American way of life is not possible without a commitment to security, both at home and abroad. We need to secure our borders, enforce the rule of law in our cities and communities, and recommit to bold American leadership on the world stage.

Peter,
My sister Susheela Jayapal led a strong, principled, progressive campaign. And I couldn’t be more proud of her.
She was met with an onslaught of outside spending from dark money super PACs and attacks from the far-right. Why? Because she _dared_ to challenge the status quo to stand up for the people of Portland against Republican inaction.
Let’s be clear: Republicans spent millions of dollars to diminish our voter power and buy this election. **But no amount of money will silence the movement we’re building to usher in a new generation of compassionate and bold leaders.**
This is not the end, Peter. Elections should be decided by voters, not bought by mega-donors. We must get money out of our politics.

| | I'm thrilled to announce that we crushed last night’s Republican Primary Election!

This victory belongs to every one of you who stood by me, volunteered your time, shared our message, and voted for our no-nonsense conservative values

Even with a massive smear campaign and hundreds of thousands of dollars spent against us, we proved that true conservatism is alive and kicking in Nampa, Idaho.

As your Senator, I pledge to keep fighting tooth and nail for what's best for Idaho. I'll continue to battle for what matters most: securing and protecting our constitutional rights, demanding fiscal accountability, restoring quality education, and upholding traditional family values.

_**_I'll always stand up to the establishment and radical Democrats trying to wreck our way of life_**_** _._**

[](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=1af82ce221&e=dea908e0fe)

In 2022, a red wave hit Idaho hard. Last night, we did it again.

I want to thank my family for their unwavering support throughout this campaign.

To the volunteers who worked tirelessly to spread our message and mobilize voters, your dedication has been the backbone of this campaign. Thank you for standing strong in our fight.

To the voters of Nampa, thank you for trusting me and seeing through the lies and sleazy attack ads.**__**_**_You saw the real me_**_** _._** You sent a clear message that we won't stand by while our economy is wrecked, our constitutional rights are stripped, our kids are corrupted, and our southern border is left wide open.

**_You've shown that we won't tolerate corruption and complacency in our government._**

This victory is just the beginning. There's a lot of work to be done, and I'm ready to roll up my sleeves and fight for the people of Nampa, Idaho.

With my colleagues in the Idaho Freedom Caucus, we'll drain the Boise swamp, restore integrity to our government, and make sure our voices are heard.

[**Join me in this fight**](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=466ddc11cd&e=dea908e0fe "join me")

Cheers,

Brian
Nampa's Conservative Senator
District 13

**P.S.** I still have a Democrat to beat in November, but we just took down a "philosophical Democrat" last night, so... let's do it one more time!

name: Morning in Nevada PAC
subject: Endorsement Alert: Morning in Nevada PAC Releases Endorsements
body:
We need more Republicans in office. That is why we are announcing a list of endorsements in key races across the state. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/morninginnevadapac/endorsements?e=b87806bd09)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter,
This time of year is critical for Republicans in Nevada as we approach Primary Election Day. With a Republican Governor holding the executive branch, we must help send more Republicans to the Capitol as reinforcements for our Governor so that we don't end up in the super minority in both the Assembly and the Senate. While we often hear people talk about how disastrous it would be for the radical left to be in the supermajority, let's think about it practically. Radical liberals in the legislature would be able to pass any legislation they want including tax increases, a ban on gas stoves, reducing penalties for a multitude of crimes, gun control, anti-hunting measures, and many more. There is no such thing as a moderate Democrat in Nevada. If Democrats are in the supermajority, expect every liberal California policy to be passed with ease. We must send a message to these Democrats: Don't California My Nevada. It's not just their radical policies that threaten us, it's their values. We have seen what happens in other states when the radicals take over, and we are at the last stand here in Nevada.

With that being said, **we must support Republican candidates who have the best chance to beat the Democrats** in November. In pursuit of that same goal, we are releasing an endorsement slate for the upcoming primary and general elections.
---
|
---
|
---
| Primary Election Day is just three weeks away ... and early voting begins soon here in Nevada.

At Morning in Nevada PAC, we are leading the fight to turn Nevada RED this year ... and we need [your continued support](https://morninginnevadapac.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=047a240fc40ae6cc0e2ac8dec&id=bdb4f0b988&e=b87806bd09) to succeed.

_**At this very moment, we are intensely engaged in Nevada’s critical swing-district races, communicating directly with voters about what’s at stake in this election and what they need to do to save our state.**_

We don’t need to tell you what the Democrats’ dangerous agenda has done to Nevadans. Skyrocketing costs and crushing inflation. Rising crime. Poor education for our kids. You’re painfully aware of the Democrats’ record of failure.

Now, we’re hard at work making sure that the voters who will be decisive in this year’s crucial elections have the information they need to make the right choices.

And you can help make that happen.

_**We hope you’ll [contribute to our efforts today by clicking here](https://morninginnevadapac.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=047a240fc40ae6cc0e2ac8dec&id=7ad4396166&e=b87806bd09). A contribution of $500, $250, $100, $25 or any amount you can give will go directly toward our voter-contact efforts for the final two weeks ahead.**_

Many of you have let us know that you’ve seen some of what we’ve been sending out in these key races. And we greatly appreciate the positive feedback. Remember: It is only because of your generous support that we’re able to fight effectively to save our state.

_**Now, you can help us keep the momentum going all the way through November 8. **_[_**Just click here to contribute to our efforts today.**_](https://morninginnevadapac.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=047a240fc40ae6cc0e2ac8dec&id=d62f555e50&e=b87806bd09)

A Red Wave is absolutely within our reach. We must hold Republican seats in the Nevada Legislature, and we must flip seats within close grasp so we can send Republican majorities to Carson City next year.

But we need your continued support to make it happen.

Please, [click here](https://morninginnevadapac.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=047a240fc40ae6cc0e2ac8dec&id=3070cdfc53&e=b87806bd09) and pitch in whatever you can to make the Red Wave a reality in Nevada this year. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Morning in Nevada PAC [](https://morninginnevadapac.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=047a240fc40ae6cc0e2ac8dec&id=b0377485fe&e=b87806bd09)

After the 9/11 attacks of my senior year of high school, I went off to the Naval Academy at 17-years old. Like so many veterans of my age, I felt the strong call to serve, to defend this country. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85420075/474710725/270139708?refcode=email_052224_service&amounts=5,15,25,50,100,250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOTY3ODU0MC01NTE4LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cXJJMyPmcluw2T42OvT1tJJwwOj_xsY_wV1U_W-PsX4=) That service took me all over the world: two deployments at sea and a tour on the ground in Iraq. That decision to serve changed my life and still impacts me today, just as it does for so many of my fellow veterans.

I took an oath to defend and serve our Constitution and this country. So when I saw people who call themselves “patriots” storm the Capitol to overthrow our government and the results of the 2020 presidential election, I was furious.

I refuse to stand by and let election deniers and conspiracy theorists take control of our government. I’ll fight day in and day out to defend our democracy, our right to vote, and every freedom that we hold dear.

**And here’s the deal: We have the chance to defend our democracy by taking back the House this November.** [**Derek, the path to winning the House runs through PA-17. body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
Last Thursday, I watched from Washington as a rapid and unexpected storm hit Houston and Southeast Texas—a storm that included a derecho, tornadoes, severe thunderstorms, and high winds. The storm left behind halved houses, shattered skyscrapers, uprooted trees, downed power lines, and much more, destroying homes and buildings and leaving nearly a million people without power. We’ve seen our share—more than our share—of huge storms in Houston. But this one was different. And devastating.
I was able to get home on Friday to see hard-hit areas in the district and visit with our local leaders responding to the storms. Once again, our community is responding to this extreme weather event with compassion and competence. And we’re seeing again how much leadership matters. I am grateful to the first responders and the local leaders in our community who are helping our community respond and recover. We are reminded how important it is to have leaders who are caring and collaborative.
In less than 24 hours, President Biden signed a Presidential Disaster Declaration. Upon receiving the request from Governor Greg Abbott, President Biden did not stop to ask whether Texas is a red state or a blue state. Of course, this is what we all expect and deserve. But we have seen that not all elected officials—and not even all candidates for President—operate this way. It is a reminder of the stakes of this year’s election, as well as a reminder of how important it is to elect people to every office who will approach governing collaboratively and constructively.
We know all too well that the recovery process will be long and will require continued collaboration. I will work with my team to do all we can to support those efforts, to support our community, and to ensure we have the tools and resources necessary for recovery, rebuilding, and healing.
Together, we can do anything,

clean_body: ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [] Last Thursday, I watched from Washington as a rapid and unexpected storm hit Houston and Southeast Texas—a storm that included a derecho, tornadoes, severe thunderstorms, and high winds. The storm left behind halved houses, shattered skyscrapers, uprooted trees, downed power lines, and much more, destroying homes and buildings and leaving nearly a million people without power. We’ve seen our share—more than our share—of huge storms in Houston. But this one was different. And devastating. I was able to get home on Friday to see hard-hit areas in the district and visit with our local leaders responding to the storms. Once again, our community is responding to this extreme weather event with compassion and competence. And we’re seeing again how much leadership matters. I am grateful to the first responders and the local leaders in our community who are helping our community respond and recover. We are reminded how important it is to have leaders who are caring and collaborative. In less than 24 hours, President Biden signed a Presidential Disaster Declaration. Upon receiving the request from Governor Greg Abbott, President Biden did not stop to ask whether Texas is a red state or a blue state. Of course, this is what we all expect and deserve. But we have seen that not all elected officials—and not even all candidates for President—operate this way. It is a reminder of the stakes of this year’s election, as well as a reminder of how important it is to elect people to every office who will approach governing collaboratively and constructively. We know all too well that the recovery process will be long and will require continued collaboration. I will work with my team to do all we can to support those efforts, to support our community, and to ensure we have the tools and resources necessary for recovery, rebuilding, and healing. Together, we can do anything, LizzieSignature [] 3262 Westheimer, PMB 636, Houston, TX 77098 PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS Don't want to receive these emails anymore? unsubscribe: www.lizziefletcher.com []

Honestly, for most of us on this team, it’s not the first race we’ve worked on — which means we know how special this campaign is.
It’s not just that, as an LGBTQ+ Native American who was raised by a single mom, worked her own way through school, and used to be a professional MMA fighter — and flipped a GOP-held seat — Sharice broke through a ton of barriers to get to Congress.
It’s not even that she’s Kansas’ only elected Democratic representative in Washington.
It’s that despite the incredible chaos and dysfunction of D.C., Sharice has delivered real results for all of us: lower drug costs for seniors, good-paying clean-energy jobs in our district, bipartisan action to reduce gun violence, and long-overdue support for farmers and ranchers. The list keeps going.

Hi there
Friend,

If you're
like me, it is easy to get overwhelmed by all the ways to study
God's Word - we have books, apps, and reading plans. It can even
be hard to decide on where to go next! So I wanted to share an
opportunity with you as you look to spend more time in God's Word
and grow in your relationship with Him.

At Today
in the Word, our mission is to help believers grow closer to
Christ through daily Bible study and real-life application. So
we've developed daily devotionals written by the professors of
Moody Bible Institute to help you stay in the Word, be inspired
to walk with the Lord, and remain engaged with God's truth every
day.

Our
bite-sized devotionals - delivered straight to your inbox every
morning - offer Scripture readings, encouraging messages, and
practical applications to help you:

Overcome life's
challenges and find hope
Deepen your faith
and broaden your knowledge of Scripture
Experience God's
love in a rich and personal way
Start your day
with gospel-centered mindset

Each month, we
explore a new book of the Bible or a relevant topic like
overcoming fear, resting in God's faithfulness, or continuing on
spiritual growth.
Join thousands of
brothers and sisters in Christ who are already experiencing the
power of God's Word in this approchable way through Today in the
Word daily devotionals.
Ready to dive in?
Sign up for our daily
devotionals at the link below today! We'd love to have you join
us!

clean_body: What is Campaign Camp? We're glad you asked... | | | Hi Peter, Are you passionate about driving change in your community? Are you eager to enhance your organizing skills and make a difference in electoral campaigns? But what actually is Campaign Camp? We're glad you asked. Campaign Camp is an intensive program designed to support and train a diverse community of activists, volunteers, candidates, and campaign staff. During your time at Campaign Camp, you will learn about topics like fundraising, communications tactics, voter contact, and so much more from experienced activists, organizers, and campaigners. Basically, Camp is for anyone interested in learning about running a campaign. This includes organizers, activists, experienced candidates, and people considering a run for office. We even know of some participants who decided to run for office after attending! Programs like WFP’s Campaign Camp are so valuable because they help train and grow grassroots leaders throughout the country who are fighting for what our communities need — and gets us closer to achieving our dream of building a multiracial populist movement. Campaign Camp is fully virtual and runs on weekday evenings, two nights per week, from June 4th to June 27th. And hey, we get it — life's busy. You don't have to commit to every single session. Feel free to pick and choose what works best for you based on your interests and availability. Local teams are encouraged to arrange additional in-person gatherings if there's interest so you may still get a chance to have some face time with your fellow Campers. So, what do you say? Dear Peter,
Today, a British Court heard a case regarding the jailed founder of Wikileaks, Julian Assange. He has been incarcerated in the UK for over 5 years because the US is demanding he be sent to the US to stand trial.
Wikileaks, you may remember, exposed crimes committed by several US government actors, including, most of all, the US military. But instead of being celebrated for exposing wrongdoing, he has suffered a decade of persecution by the architects of those very crimes. They want Assange sent to the US to face charges that could land the is hero in prison for life.
The attorneys for Assange, who is an Australian citizen, sought assurances “that the applicant [Assange] is permitted to rely on the First Amendment, that the applicant is not prejudiced at trial, including sentence, by reason of his nationality, that he is afforded the same first amendment [free speech] protections as a United States citizen, and that the death penalty is not imposed.”
Julian’s attorneys achieved a legal victory in this hearing. _The Guardian_ reported:
| | In a short ruling, the judges said the (U.S. government - ed.) submissions were not sufficient, granting Assange permission to a full appeal in relation to the points on freedom of speech and nationality.
---
This means Julian will remain imprisoned in the UK while his legal team prepares his appeal.

Peter,
It’s been a great month for getting federal dollars invested in Texas – and I’m incredibly proud that Team Casar has helped secure and deliver some of these dollars to our district and state.
Here’s just a quick snapshot of what we helped deliver, alongside House Democrats and the Biden Administration:

* **$850,000** for Huston-Tillotson University to renovate residence halls and the student union

* **Over $400 million** for Texas’s power grid reliability and clean energy, as part of the Biden administration’s Solar for All program

When I stepped into the role of representing West Michigan, I did so not only as a legislator but as a mother determined to make our government more inclusive and responsive to the needs of families like ours.

Despite the growing influence of mom legislators like myself, the obstacles to entering and staying in elected office remain daunting. Today, mothers make up just 23% of lawmakers. This disparity doesn't just affect me; it affects every policy that impacts our families—from childcare to healthcare.

In 2022, I became the first pro-choice woman and mother elected to serve Michigan’s 3rd district. Since then, I've fought every day to protect and expand access to childcare, safeguard women's healthcare, and ensure our government mirrors the people it serves. But now, my ability to continue this crucial work is at risk.

National Republicans have named my seat a target, and they’re spending millions to unseat me. It’s crucial we keep up our momentum and reach out to voters across our district. Now more than ever, we need leaders in Congress who understand firsthand the challenges and aspirations of mothers and families.

| **John Duarte Earns Endorsement from the International Union of Police Associations (I.U.P.A)**
---
| | **Merced, CA** — The International Union of Police Associations (I.U.P.A.) endorsed John Duarte’s 2024 re-election campaign. For forty years, the International Union of Police Associations has fought to protect law enforcement personnel and ensure they have the necessary resources to protect our communities. The endorsement from I.U.P.A. highlights John Duarte's commitment to protecting those who serve in uniform.

“I am honored to receive the endorsement of the International Union of Police Associations,” said John Duarte. “Our law enforcement officers work, day in and day out, often in dangerous situations to keep our neighborhoods safe. In Congress, I am committed to standing alongside our police officers to make sure they have the support and resources to do their job safely and effectively.”

John Duarte’s 2024 campaign has seen a swell of support from public safety leaders and organizations, including the Peace Officers Research Association of California (PORAC), Turlock Associated Police Officers, Madera County D.A. Sally O. Moreno, and many others. For more information about John Duarte and his campaign, please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=a440b90f73&e=76a47b375f). ###

body:
Startling Vote Registration Numbers Lead To Election Upset?
| | **Can't see this message?_[View in a browser](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=bxfAjvz1kS5-LZY9e9lHMj26pg6144TomkI1eFPpYSU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3NvLzhhT19YUTltaT9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)_**

| | |
---
| |
---
| |
# In This Newsletter

1. Oh What A Tangled Web We Weave
2. Two Groups Bring Victory To Central and Eastern Washington
3. It Is In The Mail . . . Almost
4. TikTok, TikTok: Biden
5. Freedom Is A Constitutional Right: So Why Don't We Have It?

---
| | |
---
| | 1\. Oh What A Tangled Web We Weave
---
| | In the realm of Democrats, truth reigns supreme,Where accountability is not just a dream.Should error arise, we first look within,For in self-reflection, our journey begins.
Yet as we traverse this path of integrity,We ponder the cost of our moral decree.For while lies and deceit may briefly succeed,Their shadowy presence plants a perilous seed.
>From the depths of MAGA, corruption unfurls,An egotistical tempest that disrupts and whirls.When virtue is mocked, and greed is extolled,The foundation of justice begins to erode.
In the realm of Democratic ideals, we stand,Clarity our beacon, guiding our hand.Though the road may be rugged, the journey steep,We uphold our values, in darkness, we keep.
For even in the bleakest of night's embrace,The moon's gentle glow reveals grace.So let us remain steadfast, in our quest for the right,For in the flicker of hope, we find our might.
---
| | |
---
| | 2\. Two Groups Bring Victory To Central and Eastern Washington
---
| | The local, state, and national Democratic Party help to hold the line. They energize the base, canvass those who identify as Democrats, and get out the vote for those Democrats who vote intermittently. This delivers a little over 30% of the votes cast in Central and Eastern Washington. Rural Americans United focuses on the other 21% needed to win. Where are these votes found? Voters who are newly registered or never voted.
---
| |
---
| | Source Washington State voter registration database: Newly registered voters We are supported by an excellent data team and leverage relationships with the University of Washington’s[ Election Database Team](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=tcfJMBPtHdfYw1ZIB_68veSwMZqpSNCwKoyS1xCIAPY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93YWVsZWN0aW9uZGF0YS5jc2RlLndhc2hpbmd0b24uZWR1L3BfMDgwX3RlYW0uaHRtbCIsInIiOiJkYmJiZjEyNS1kYjc4LTQ5MzEtYTMzOC04ZGQ0ZWIxMTIyOTIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) and, more recently, the[ Minority and Justice Commission](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=GFZucS6DwwO0xzuFuLbf4B5cYZOg9eLxZB4jV7Hjuos.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY291cnRzLndhLmdvdi8_ZmE9aG9tZS5zdWImb3JnPW1qYyIsInIiOiJkYmJiZjEyNS1kYjc4LTQ5MzEtYTMzOC04ZGQ0ZWIxMTIyOTIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). Newly registered voters and registered voters who haven’t voted make up a huge, virtually untapped group. Having never voted, these groups do not have an identified political affiliation and therefore receive little to no attention from political parties, which spend resources on potential votes, not voters. Data on newly registered voters was introduced in the last[ blog](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=025_49zT6OpMHeFrIN-CZktwJ7hGgkUQkAjwgC_iN6I.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvdGhlLXdhc2hpbmd0b24tc3RhdGUtZ29wLWhhcy1kZWNsYXJlZC13YXItb24tZGVtb2NyYWN5IiwiciI6ImRiYmJmMTI1LWRiNzgtNDkzMS1hMzM4LThkZDRlYjExMjI5MiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9), and non-voters, titled 'unheard voices,' was discussed in a previous[ blog](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=025_49zT6OpMHeFrIN-CZktwJ7hGgkUQkAjwgC_iN6I.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3Bvc3QvdGhlLXdhc2hpbmd0b24tc3RhdGUtZ29wLWhhcy1kZWNsYXJlZC13YXItb24tZGVtb2NyYWN5IiwiciI6ImRiYmJmMTI1LWRiNzgtNDkzMS1hMzM4LThkZDRlYjExMjI5MiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9).
---
| |
---
| | Source Washington State voter registration database: Newly registered voters in April 2024 for counties in Central and Eastern Washington Newly registered voters are, for this election cycle, the most expedient to reach. Rural Americans United, with the generous help of Nils Whitmont, has compiled a database of newly registered voters. From here, we can start to strategize on how best to target and persuade. Voter registration drives are only a small, labor-intensive portion. While we are grateful to all the organizations that stand at a table all day to register voters, it is not the best use of Rural American United’s resources. However, looking at the breakdown of voters by county, we can see opportunities to contact voters in key areas where even a slight increase in voter turnout could swing elections toward Democrats. Biden lost Walla Walla County by 6% and Spokane County by 4%.
---
| |
---
| | Source Washington State voter registration database: Newly registered voters in April 2024 for counties in Central and Eastern Washington Rural Americans United will launch a campaign next month to initially deliver 1,000 postcards per month to key areas. We will measure success based on changes in voter turnout and confirming which newly registered voters did vote. The projected cost of this project is $12,000. We hope you see the value in this exercise as we do and contribute generously.
---
| | |
---
| | 3\. It Is In The Mail . . . Almost
---
| | Thank you to all our generous donors who have contributed $25 or $50 per month for six months! We're thrilled to announce that in June, we'll be ordering mugs or hats for your delivery. And for those of you who've supported us with recurring donations of $5 per month, we're sending you a beautiful refrigerator magnet. Your continuous support truly makes our work possible. Thank you!
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=STr_9VL5dLwYABwlQnWFbQK5IbqOJTjrOa8PAmabs0Y.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdSIsInIiOiJhOThhNjdjNi1jYjZhLTQ3NWItYTJjNy03ZmU5NmExNTM1N2YiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)
---
| | |
---
| | 4\. TikTok, TikTok: Biden
---
| | Who wins an election when only one person is running? I created this [TikTok](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=yeYl_g5FnrtMVMCO-p7lQ70OO6vumW9k07OhzAu0ELU.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGlrdG9rLmNvbS9Ad2hpdGVkb3VnbGFzMi92aWRlby83MzcwMDgwMzA1Mzc5NjQyNjY3P2xhbmc9ZW4iLCJyIjoiMTFlNWZjNjYtODQ0Zi00OTRjLWFmNDYtNzAyMWEwZTBiYjg4IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) out of frustration with the media and Biden's campaign. Biden has accomplished so much and yet receives little to no attention. In a recent issue of [The New Republic](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/8aO_XQ9mi/c?w=lBtARz2bZZsIGD3m4DpL0B_VFgLZRHWXQIASVeqHa24.), eleven articles were featured: Five focused on Trump, five on Trump's cronies, and only one on Biden, titled 'Democrats Have A Joe Biden Problem.' Biden's treatment by the media is quite literally a 'with friends like that, who needs enemies?' story.
Transcript: I am a solid Democrat engaged in politics, and my news feeds definitely reflect that. The economy is doing well, inflation is down, the stock market is up, investment in our country is booming, and we are strong on the world stage. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In light of the International Criminal Court’s (ICC) investigation of
October 7th’s events and the war crimes that have taken place since, the
ICC is now seeking arrest warrants for Hamas leaders as well as Prime
Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Israeli Minister of Defense Yoav Gallant.

Most of the international community can see that what’s happening to
Palestinians under Netanyahu’s far-right administration is genocide and
ethnic cleansing — but here in the United States, President Biden and his
administration continue to stand by Netanyahu and his horrific war crimes
against innocent people.

President Biden condemned these arrest warrants while celebrating a
similar warrant issued for Russian President Vladimir Putin, and is now
collaborating with anti-Palestinian Democrats and Republicans in Congress
to formally sanction the ICC.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240522_icc/?source=em20240522-34921&akid=34921%2E1203867%2EDAV6vk ]Tweet from Financial Times: Biden administration signals it will
support bipartisan push to sanction ICC

As U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders said, “We cannot apply international law
only when it’s convenient.” Either we stand against war crimes, or we
don’t.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240522_icc/?source=em20240522-34921&akid=34921%2E1203867%2EDAV6vk ]Tell the Biden Administration: Stop enabling genocide and DON’T
sanction the ICC for working to hold Netanyahu accountable for his crimes
against humanity.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240522_icc/?source=em20240522-34921&akid=34921%2E1203867%2EDAV6vk ]Take Action

If the Biden Administration goes forward with its threats to sanction the
ICC, the President will only continue to lead us down a dangerous path
that will have negative repercussions both here and abroad.

With a majority of Democratic voters agreeing that Israel is committing
genocide, and supporting a permanent ceasefire and immediate release of
all hostages, Biden is risking a Trump presidency for the sake of denying
genocide and defending war criminals.

If the Biden Administration and Congress retaliate against the ICC, it
will shred what’s left of the United States’ credibility in the world as a
country that respects international law and the institutions that uphold
it. The ICC must be given the ability to investigate and prosecute war
crimes—no matter who is being accused of them.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/sign/petition_20240522_icc/?source=em20240522-34921&akid=34921%2E1203867%2EDAV6vk ]Sign our petition now to demand this administration change course and

Justice Democrats

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
Dr. Bob Lorinser is the ideal candidate to represent Michigan's First District in the U.S. Congress. As a lifelong Yooper and retired combat veteran, I have closely observed Dr. Lorinser's character and commitment, and he stands head and shoulders above the rest. Can you join me in supporting him today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
CONTRIBUTE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
Friends,
First, a little about me: I was born and raised here, served in the military, saw combat in Afghanistan, and returned home after retiring from the Joint Staff.
I voted first mainly for Republicans and finally as a staunchly independent voter. I looked for candidates based on these criteria: wisdom, knowledge and experience, compassion, charisma and positivity, and, above all, integrity, which is the military's first Core Value.
It's hard to find a candidate who embodies them all, but Dr. Bob does. I first met him at a town hall meeting back in 2020. I critiqued everything he said, found the chance to speak with him afterward, and, over time, realized that he had met all of the above.
Dr. Lorinser has deep roots in our community, evident in his lifelong actions. He has lived here for over thirty years, serving as a dedicated physician for our families. Unlike other candidates who only claim to be from here or moved here just before running for office, Dr. Lorinser and his family are true Yoopers who understand our unique way of life and the challenges we face.
Dr. Lorinser's campaign is fueled by grassroots support. He doesn't rely on large corporate donations or dark money. Instead, he humbly asks for our contributions, making us the primary funding source for his campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blairbob]
This ensures that he remains independent and accountable only to us, the residents of the First District.
As for all other candidates, scrutinize their backgrounds, including residency in our district, employment, and the
origins of their campaign contributions. I'm sure you'll see Dr. Bob is far above all others. I know he will make us proud as our representative in Congress. As a matter of fact, I guarantee it.
— Blair J. Anderson,
Master Sergeant, United States Air Force (Ret.)

#
Peter,
**[If Senator Durbin is going to stay on pace with his end-of-month fundraising goal and with millions the GOP is spending to take back the Senate, he needs 20 people to donate before tonight at midnight. What can we say to convince you to chip in?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85433508/474746943/-1447414995?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.05.22_B1_WeSay_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzYxZTc0NC02NjE4LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EIzRur3AKjDxqd_G31kUS3BivIe-TF2AveeL0VGEXGQ=)**
We could tell you that Republicans only need to flip a handful of seats to take back control of the Senate. Democrats are defending two-thirds of the seats up for election this November in several states that Trump won by a landslide in 2020.
We could tell you that the stakes of this election couldn’t be higher. Our Democratic Senate majority is the only thing standing between a nationwide abortion ban and cuts to Medicare and Social Security.

name: David Hogg (Leaders We Deserve)
subject: BOOM another win
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Bryce Berry is a leader we deserve in the Georgia legislature.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240522&t=1&akid=715%2E587540%2E32UdC6)
Big news out of Georgia last night, Peter!
**Two of our Leaders-endorsed candidates, Bryce Berry and Ashwin Ramaswami, won their primaries and will now face off against Republicans in November.**
Today, I want to talk a little bit about Bryce Berry’s race and why it is so important that we win this crucial Atlanta-area House seat back from the GOP in November.
Bryce is a young Atlanta public school teacher, non-profit leader, and community organizer who is running on a platform of economic development, strong public education, affordable housing and health care, and solutions to reduce gun violence.
He decided to run when one day his principal told him that one of his students had witnessed his father get shot and killed in front of him the night before — when Bryce checked in with the student, he said “It’s ok, this kind of thing happens all the time.” When Bryce witnessed the normalization of gun violence so close, he knew he had to do more for his students.
That is why he’s running against GOP State Rep. Mesha Mainor, **_a former Democrat_** who switched parties and **_became a Republican_** after voting to defund Georgia’s public schools last year.1 Mainor is completely out of touch with this district.
**[Bryce won his primary, but now the real fight begins. Can you rush in a $5 donation to help Bryce defeat his party-switching opponent in November?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240522?refcode=em20240522&amount=5&refcode2=715_587540_32UdC6&akid=715%2E587540%2E32UdC6)**
Peter, President Biden only won Georgia by 11,779 votes in 2020.2 And with swing state polls showing Biden’s support eroding among young, non-white voters3, **we need progressive candidates of color like Bryce on the ballot _more than ever_.**
Bryce’s race is an opportunity to not only return this important legislative seat back to Democratic control, but also a way to help Biden turn out the voters he’ll need on his side in order to win the state of Georgia again and secure his reelection.
We are going to be pouring resources into this race to ensure a big win in this election, but we can only elect the next generation of leaders with your support.
**[Contribute $5 or whatever you can to help propel Bryce to victory over his anti-public education, party-switching Republican opponent in November!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240522?refcode=em20240522&amount=5&refcode2=715_587540_32UdC6&akid=715%2E587540%2E32UdC6)**

Thanks for everything you’re doing,
David Hogg

Fellow American,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Fellow American, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

[**Congress needs more people like me**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=ba183304f7144bee807bf329d129b641&_e=Wx0Oo7qgtCN3-XX31Fwzztoyzzg2AO4N2BBMGfh3uxcMqZQqjf4RwhYv15W0uMrZwFipQmOd1MfTpc4bP3a3wIr7ADaI9eBGoGI_FTS5SM6H502DTqx-Nc7B2_lbvakaQ_q1YCrFE5ZufH1l9JG5eZd2N0U4AJC4MsIqPFA-qngej7AARSgxlKmsnbhsO3tL_hbjneXFoo0ViF-nplKq0J_ANTGzVcKyyfOeSRv1ZEGpRrv-ydTtC0zjw__GPM02kfcTk5YLzAwIxcbJ0uikUPaTI9CeLlaUw9ExZ9Gc7r3Uyl6ed9qjRooofhbgEHxU3x1wBO4o5kBj1dQ7T_5lzZfczLBF1M7CKlTuCaXhSId-rUZPVEpE_xiUlHKeWj6R) - someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. _Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices._

I desperately need the help of grassroots supporters just like you to keep this campaign running. body:
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1251%2E62735%2EMaDhVp)
| | | Dear Peter I hope this message finds you well. As we gear up for the crucial battle ahead to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate,**I'm reaching out to share some disappointing news regarding the state of our democratic process.** You may have heard about the recent cancellation of the bipartisan U.S. Senate debate scheduled for May 30th, during the Mackinac Policy Conference. **This cancellation was not due to lack of interest from the candidates, but rather the refusal of Elissa Slotkin to participate at the last minute.** I am deeply concerned over this refusal. The Detroit Regional Chamber, the organizing body, rightly points out that **this last minute cancellation undermines our democratic principles and deprives Michigan citizens of the opportunity to hear directly from those vying for their trust. ** This refusal to engage in open discourse deprives voters of the chance to evaluate candidates side by side, to scrutinize their platforms, and to make informed decisions. **It's a missed opportunity to uphold the tradition of civic engagement and public discourse that has been a cornerstone of our democracy.** As we move forward in this campaign, I remain committed to transparency, accountability, and the values that represent the best interests of Michigan families and communities.**I believe that every voter deserves the chance to hear directly from their candidates, to ask tough questions, and to demand answers.** [**That's why I'm asking for your support today. Together, we can stand up against the trend of political evasion and ensure that the voices of Michigan citizens are heard loud and clear.**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1563?t=2&akid=1251%2E62735%2EMaDhVp) Your contribution will help us amplify our message, reach more voters, and fight for a better future for all.

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Coming soon...

body:
Friends,
Thank you for being a part of my team - and “Team Democracy” - for so long. I am grateful for your friendship and support over the years.

I’m writing to share some special news with you. In early 2021 I started writing about what I saw, experienced, and lived through as one of the “Women from Michigan” in 2020.
Turns out I had a lot to write about.

It began as a firsthand account of what it was like to have a front row seat to a nationally coordinated effort to undo the fair and legitimate results of a Presidential election. It evolved into a book that, I hope, is an empowering roadmap for how we, in these divisive, uncertain times, can channel our fears and frustrations into fighting as warriors on behalf of ourselves and our community. It’s called “The Purposeful Warrior: standing up for yourself and your country,” and it will be published in early 2025 by Maria Shriver’s imprint, “The Open Field,” at Penguin Random House.

I’ll have more to share on that - including a link for you to pre-order the book - in the months ahead. For now I just wanted you to be one of the first to know about this labor of love I’ve been working on for the last three years. I’m really excited for you to read it.

It’s a busy month in a busy year as we work to defend a democracy under attack.

I’m leading the charge to push back against false political claims to make sure everyone knows the truth: Only US citizens who are legally registered to vote can cast a ballot. [https://twitter.com/JocelynBenson/status/1791565538226737321]

I’ll be joining my fellow chief election officers from Pennsylvania, Georgia and Arizona on Meet The Press this Sunday to talk about the work we are doing to prepare for safe and secure elections this November. Tune in and let me know what you think. [https://www.nbcnews.com/meet-the-press]

Don’t sleep on Florida, because Michigan has shown how in just a few years - when women roll up their sleeves and support each other - we can achieve great things that no one saw coming. That’s why last weekend I traveled to Florida to speak with democratic leaders and organizers there on how they can follow Michigan’s lead and make Florida the next Michigan. Politico covered some of the advice I gave them on how to link the fight for reproductive freedom to economic freedom to political freedom. Because it’s all connected, and it’s all the same fight. [https://www.politico.com/newsletters/florida-playbook/2024/05/20/michigans-lessons-for-florida-democrats-00158821]

It’s been a busy 2024 - and we are just getting warmed up. But don’t worry, I won’t flood your email inboxes every time we have an update. I will be posting frequently on Instagram in the months ahead though, so be sure to follow me there @JocelynBenson [https://www.instagram.com/jocelynbenson/?hl=en] to stay on top of all the things you can do to help us defend democracy - in 2024 and beyond.

I am so thankful for all that you do. Keep in touch, and see you soon.

Warmly,

Jocelyn

PO Box 21368,
Detroit MI 48221.

— James Carville

subject: Nothing will work unless you do
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Mace for Congress
body:
Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it. | [ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=07234649a7c34a41b5056b5e8d048e6f&_e=Xtd26YugadQ2BjvY-GkNOL-Zhc8ALLG0kkEP-EngEJuLzKFz_7b5aY7HrgCmU92W9adyIZ0FdF9keim_dsxCY7hMtZaBOzAY1SjuuIKoGQzDq01oRO-36XgPYTHq-twaDfVduemSrlm7f8dqo3Z7Ugcd0JbEFSF3MyHWOBYcsddSsJAHjLZzjnL2LcH-auuhDiVVDMpZn0rp-zcjlcu0hpR4MxKqxaYAISWC9VDMO1zuxd_gFg3LjUG36r59lf9dE8yzyliuk6T5nk9uH9iolSKYgdC4RnwDtHZG3DI5AMXAkOb5KgoJhKm4Vwh_izslU1Yvww43oNbudbjyZFD-6W8P66D7MWmslntMOiVtxHwhp-7aD2RR_8eDsl0Ntcig)
---
Peter,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Peter, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

[** ****SEND A HARD-WORKING WOMAN TO CONGRESS » **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=07234649a7c34a41b5056b5e8d048e6f&_e=Xtd26YugadQ2BjvY-GkNOL-Zhc8ALLG0kkEP-EngEJuLzKFz_7b5aY7HrgCmU92W9adyIZ0FdF9keim_dsxCY7hMtZaBOzAY1SjuuIKoGQzDq01oRO-36XgPYTHq-twaDfVduemSrlm7f8dqo3Z7Ugcd0JbEFSF3MyHWOBYcsddSsJAHjLZzjnL2LcH-auuhDiVVDMpZn0rp-zcjlcu0hpR4MxKqxaYAISWC9VDMO1wbUlaRJ4v_af9Ilp0CAWWxnVS3dA01F4mzBuIWPmNE_7CiZex12pt4G4s9or03Kc3c5H63ny3g5GnFjeHKcAwCDGuGpNWIent-B88uBK8ogkLmuRNsAj2fa9EkiEOCuaHlktkm-fW5Bf2T8pOVh4KB)

[**Congress needs more people like me**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=07234649a7c34a41b5056b5e8d048e6f&_e=Xtd26YugadQ2BjvY-GkNOL-Zhc8ALLG0kkEP-EngEJuLzKFz_7b5aY7HrgCmU92W9adyIZ0FdF9keim_dsxCY7hMtZaBOzAY1SjuuIKoGQzDq01oRO-36XgPYTHq-twaDfVduemSrlm7f8dqo3Z7Ugcd0JbEFSF3MyHWOBYcsddSsJAHjLZzjnL2LcH-auuhDiVVDMpZn0rp-zcjlcu0hpR4MxKqxaYAISWC9VDMO1ydlBB6jfq_K1rdC0t2XskGhhyYd91YA5CmpDOoF1Y4vHpsiscm2AVxKYa4fcs99taA7rYg_cXBJAvT84y-7MoBF74oONLNYXoPDwIoEH3sikLRuXtMH3ZJOTmvI9V_TMLTq_qkNqq2DUk7evck9V9G) - someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. _Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices._

clean_body: [] Friend, The cost of groceries in America is out of control. The reason for the price hikes, plain and simple, is corporate greed. Grocery costs have risen 25 percent since 2019. Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

You can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=521522bbea4b4b238a71911c907dab1e&_e=ZDEulf5i6MUggmn5fQqsRh0WqF0nt31Qo0MagmBP70pjHbm2ME5FxZPcbJRke1q8H3UBTGvdyjBOgPPiFrSJ2o7jQHxQz4MaEfW5H1swD9ssQEtza0tUXAfsBZu3jxjTQSgmt-A3GrPdcjgv--Erpc9QYbuBDvSjB_oXMlcImti3xHW-4iHTKS63Yvo7zh5wq18AaLDo2ma-zlpErJXrnrpn2eVzgsTHhAsPkyaaWn-MrBenrhiLNX54XFlho2LimOeTHjOWIbWK9oGKQY-oRCyX2giejmwCSyyZR-y1nq1X0qxtHzMddzVPoQrXcdqt5xVmKwKNMXxI7JQsAeKaIxZvY-NyrhOH_x7mu_IfY6PR030TqL8IzsNmYy8E9bQBso335WuOa48vozCobgmQRg%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education** , including **a required course on the Constitution**
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=521522bbea4b4b238a71911c907dab1e&_e=ZDEulf5i6MUggmn5fQqsRh0WqF0nt31Qo0MagmBP70pjHbm2ME5FxZPcbJRke1q8H3UBTGvdyjBOgPPiFrSJ2o7jQHxQz4MaEfW5H1swD9ssQEtza0tUXAfsBZu3jxjTQSgmt-A3GrPdcjgv--Erpc9QYbuBDvSjB_oXMlcImti3xHW-4iHTKS63Yvo7zh5wq18AaLDo2ma-zlpErJXrnrpn2eVzgsTHhAsPkyaaWn818b58iC3SzrgiZk3MUVhkXYqJmLVS4YPjlJFkTp_SYFYP93p5Ya_L9J26W_gH2_LJYg5JxcJN5VbjY5HQkl28KpR9CQlftICzIU05dOyathIehN520vQGVRHIaSdiIGDHol2Va72vELvhTTYR8gMdcWLuOEJe45ZUwcdQehAJLA%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, **I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today**.
