EXTRAORDINARY ONE-TIME MESSAGE:
"CHINA'S SILENT WAR ON AMERICA"
A SERIES OF 10 WEEKLY "LESSONS"**

---
|
**Dear Friend,**

Thank you for reading this one-time message about how America is being infiltrated by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

Below is the Introduction to an Ohio-developed, 10-week "course" titled, “China’s Silent War on America”, as well as Lesson 1: “China is Undermining American National Security”.

We'll be including links to these lessons in our regular (most of the time!) Sunday emails. This is the only time you'll get a message like this from us, on this topic, so please don't worry about us spamming you!

This is brought to us by [**Keep America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=35893eba17&e=5c740fa3e2). If this message was forwarded to you from a friend, or you want to sign-up to receive these lessons directly from [**Keep America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=8ab14a3957&e=5c740fa3e2), please [**SIGN UP HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1d78a6e431&e=5c740fa3e2).

**THANK YOU!

~ Mark**

* * *
**Introduction & Lesson 1 of a 10-Week Course:
"China is Undermining American National Security**" **Introduction** Recently grassroots leaders in Ohio became acutely aware of the many national security threats posed by Communist China as Communist China attempts to embed itself into every aspect of America’s economy, politics, society (including our schools) and sovereignty. China’s major goal is to establish itself as the dominant force on the globe thereby establishing a new world order. This will require the takeover of the United States. Communist China is currently waging war with America; a war they plan on winning. It is a war where the weapons do not have physical bullets but it’s a war nonetheless. If America is to survive this war we must first arm ourselves with knowledge so we may mobilize our forces to push back against this silent invasion. We must never forget America was founded on freedom and that Communist China was founded on the suppression of freedom. These two ideologies cannot co-exist. We have an important decision to make or it will be made for us by Communist China. That said, America for Americans will provide a short lesson each of the next ten weeks to educate the reader on the many strategies China is using to undermine America’s power at home and abroad, while enriching its own homeland. The reader will also be guided towards action items to help reduce China’s influence in the state of Ohio. **Lesson 1: China’s undermining of America’s National Security**
China is currently undermining America’s national security. It is important for the reader understand national security is a broad term and frankly, has many definitions. For purposes of this series of lessons we will define National Security**** as all the actions a country takes [_to protect itself_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=90e213a5c5&e=5c740fa3e2) from its enemies. This includes not only the military, but also the protection of the country's [_values and beliefs_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=6305bdc083&e=5c740fa3e2). National security is the way a country keeps itself safe from harm and maintains its sovereignty and beliefs. For a country to have a strong national security it must not just be strong and united in its values and beliefs within its borders, it must also have [_strategic alliances_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b882759429&e=5c740fa3e2) with other like-minded countries outside of its borders and have a strong military to support these alliances. If a country is lacking in either category it is vulnerable to its enemies. America is vulnerable and China is intentionally contributing to these vulnerabilities both inside of America and abroad. China knows it must [_weaken America_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f9bba83ed2&e=5c740fa3e2) if it is to become the dominant global power. Please watch this excellent 9-minute video for a general overview of just how serious the threat of China is within the borders of America: _[Video: China: “The Defining Threat of our Generation”](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=b7dc1eaa5a&e=5c740fa3e2)_ This video seemed to list all the ways China could possibly be influencing America: that is not quite all the ways as the following article will show. Read this 3-minute article to see how Communist China has also embedded itself into many of our federal agencies, leaving Americans at the mercy of Communist China’s many nefarious schemes. _[Article: House GOP Launches Government-Wide Probe Into Federal Response to CCP Political Warfare](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=db9501604b&e=5c740fa3e2)_
_**Next Lesson, Lesson 2: China’s Goal of World Domination Using the Belt and Road Initiative.**_

**PLEASE TAKE ACTION!**

After reading Lesson 1 in the China’s Silent War on America lesson series, you now have more knowledge. Sadly, knowledge is not power-unless it is put to use. Below are two ways to make this lesson more powerful.
1. Sign up to receive lessons by [_CLICKING HERE_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=c5ac664256&e=5c740fa3e2) if this message was forwarded to you from a friend. Input your email address, name, county and state. Your information will NOT be shared with anyone but will guarantee that you receive future lessons and updates on this critical topic after the lesson series is complete.
2. Share this lesson on social media. [_CLICK HERE_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=3a59563b57&e=5c740fa3e2) to share on the Facebook. [_CLICK HERE_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=75befa0570&e=5c740fa3e2) to share on X (formerly know as Twitter).
3. Share this lesson via text or email. Simply [_copy this link_](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=7f76720315&e=5c740fa3e2) then paste it into a text or email message to at least three friends.

_We hope you enjoyed the first lesson. In a few weeks we will start to include information about the influence the Communist China has in Ohio._ _From your friends at Keep America for Americans_

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it. | [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=1b2ef713b0264fa08d2ea85f87a4ecd6&_e=z-wZ072xIpjA7Gs4hiaIOrjCG9QDIktOUjlyB8MycAIWdRo0uMKPMWmqVVetgor20Kf9Qc0qBdceilXF4BoQD-I2t8w1_xbwB67nonzaJ4n3KmOe5KI4FuIzoFvvEzM79EVPheVH65TpVh7uPUEn5OG15JIdAHHCkRzLpRlakCImJhcMq2qnbB6WZBTAJwY5s2p9bJa_HieBK8EAofnKAPavoYW8oZ1Yxyq98KqcfuiBQAMGP_BTS0tkv_L3flQ8ntSpO5YS9Pp_a6HCo0Nkp8wXdxT9N5_lRRRXsfVkz150DVGwN9ZGwVocrMSt98Cs_ReHtdGjtNfah-jwVu7q1mdZMs7jGW0i7V0y0DL8AS92fv7dK47ZTI9OYeECpwD8FpBu3KNSVzR-QiUMxaw7zA%3D%3D)
---
Peter,

My mom was a schoolteacher growing up. Every single day she got up and went to educate the next generation of leaders... and she always told me, _**"Nothing will work unless you do".**_

And it is exactly what I’ve been doing since I was 17 when I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also earned my high school diploma by taking classes at a technical college. I got by without government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

**Well, Peter, I took those same ideals I learned as a Waffle House waitress to Congress. I refuse to waiver to what anyone wants other than the constituents I was elected by,_even if it means pissing off some party members along the way._**

[** ****SEND A HARD-WORKING WOMAN TO CONGRESS » **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=1b2ef713b0264fa08d2ea85f87a4ecd6&_e=z-wZ072xIpjA7Gs4hiaIOrjCG9QDIktOUjlyB8MycAIWdRo0uMKPMWmqVVetgor20Kf9Qc0qBdceilXF4BoQD-I2t8w1_xbwB67nonzaJ4n3KmOe5KI4FuIzoFvvEzM79EVPheVH65TpVh7uPUEn5OG15JIdAHHCkRzLpRlakCImJhcMq2qnbB6WZBTAJwY5s2p9bJa_HieBK8EAofnKAPavoYW8oZ1Yxyq98Kqcfuj9nT6B57hAlEebc49vZbzERIQDyYfCGigdHud-_qTCByB8bjhXvS-PaFr5WjeiOLJLZ7Gt4ZusUoOj8Cbgl4DjYZ9p-w-_rEZgieM-1sMwftxFWwgMR2dsuQoYVJNbiRoLN9m9BdgXjjcgjVySSZrhqxpYgIYDFSPuAl9DIce3RQ%3D%3D)

[**Congress needs more people like me**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=1b2ef713b0264fa08d2ea85f87a4ecd6&_e=z-wZ072xIpjA7Gs4hiaIOrjCG9QDIktOUjlyB8MycAIWdRo0uMKPMWmqVVetgor20Kf9Qc0qBdceilXF4BoQD-I2t8w1_xbwB67nonzaJ4n3KmOe5KI4FuIzoFvvEzM79EVPheVH65TpVh7uPUEn5OG15JIdAHHCkRzLpRlakCImJhcMq2qnbB6WZBTAJwY5s2p9bJa_HieBK8EAofnKAPavoYW8oZ1Yxyq98Kqcfugu_B10kgMGYOSW9epoU5zscL_wIUPYMBtZSfgk14RrrYO9il-1S-uAw4uwp-0xgVY9vUy6-DEOwhxBLAFwbzgm12_SyiBlELh0oCOdfcg2AWytOLfdsZo1YDeXfw9cxG4Oei5R_x-6yoCUYfu9wA_y0gNWCIaE38A5_NtKzJK5Ag%3D%3D) - someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. _Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices._

body:
This is a fight for the integrity of our representation.
#
What we are here to do is to transform the politics of this country. And the only way that we will do that is by winning with mandates.
So when we talk about Jamaal Bowman, what I want us to keep in mind is that **this is not just about win or lose**.
What we have to demonstrate — not just to Republicans, but even within our own party and the entire country — is that _we are ready_ to guarantee health care to every single American.
_We are ready_ for a politics that unapologetically supports the labor movement and the right to a union.
_We are ready_ for politics that supports rights to clean air and clean water; that understands welcoming immigrants is part of supporting our success as a nation; that we have to dismantle an unjust criminal justice system, and in order to actually establish public safety, we must open paths to education.
And we do that by making sure that we aren't just aiming for mere victory. We are aiming to send Jamaal back with a mandate — **that our communities cannot be bought by special interests**.
**AIPAC spent $1.9 million against Jamaal just last week, 1 and have committed spending $18 million more until the NY primary election in less than 5 weeks. [Will you split a $2 contribution today between our campaigns — $1 for each team — to power our movement and help us win, not by a little but by _a lot,_ on June 25th? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240522-bowman.cQA0va&refcode=em20240522-6464-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6464%2E2526796%2ECV412n)
---
That's something that I don't think is discussed enough: it's not just the stances that people like Jamaal Bowman take. It's the fact that he takes them without taking a _dime_ of corporate lobbyist money.
That is a type of leader that is extraordinarily rare in our politics today, to have a member of Congress that is not funded by big money or corporate lobbies.
In my first reelection campaign the entire establishment came after me, too, and I had a $5 million primary challenge, followed by a $10 million general election challenge. Now, what Jamaal is facing is orders of magnitude _larger_ than that.
**What we have to show them is that their money is no good here.**
[Will you make a contribution right now between our campaigns so that we can win back the House? 6 swing seats run through NY, and we need to preserve each one — starting with Jamaal’s.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240522-bowman.cQA0va&refcode=em20240522-6464-P_FND_SPL_OPP&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6464%2E2526796%2ECV412n)
---
This is a fight for the integrity of our representation. Our communities cannot and should not be bought.
Our representation should not go to the highest bidder — it should go to the best leader. And that leader is Jamaal Bowman.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

body:

Derek — when
we win our Senate race here in California this November, we are also going
to flip the House of Representatives back to Democratic control. Let me
tell you how:

They’re known as the “Biden 16” — 16 Republican members of Congress on the
ballot in districts that Joe Biden won in 2020 — compared to just 5
Democrats defending Trump-won districts.

With 213 Democratic seats in the House, we just need to pick up 5 seats to
win a majority — and many of the most competitive are right here in
California. If we can fully fund our campaign to turn out voters
down-ballot, the Republicans’ House majority is toast. And it will drive
enthusiasm across the country to re-elect President Biden and defeat
Donald Trump.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240522_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1004&akid=6520%2E5257348%2E8rUQ2D ]Derek, our
resources are low after a long, all-parties jungle primary. Add a
$10
contribution to help rebuild them.

Before my campaign for the Senate, I spent many, many elections helping
Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi and congressional Democrats fight for the
House majority. One thing those experiences have proven is this: We don’t
always have the chance to get big things done, so when the opportunity
comes up, we need to take it.

I served three full terms in the House before I ever experienced
legislating from the majority — not to mention that we were dealing with a
Republican Senate and President George W. Bush at the same time!

Needless to say, it was not the most productive time in Congress if you
were a Democrat. It wasn’t until my fifth term that we had the House and
Senate majorities, and President Barack Obama in the White House, to get
some real things done. An entire decade.

And those majorities didn’t last long — just two years later, the Tea
Party movement flipped the House majority in 2010, right in time for
redistricting. GOP state legislatures brutally gerrymandered Democrats in
dozens of states. It wasn’t for another decade that we once again had the
Congress and the White House to pass the urgent priorities that had
stacked up over the past decade.

Once a decade — that’s about how often the election cycle has aligned for
us to build the majorities to make real progress like we did in 2018 and
2020. We can’t wait that long to make progress.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240522_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=6520%2E5257348%2E8rUQ2D ]We can do this,
Derek, but
I need your help. Add a contribution of
$10 to
support our campaign.

While the pundits have paid a lot of attention to the presidential and
Senate races, we cannot discount the impact that a House majority has on
our ability to make progress — the story of the Democratic and MAGA
majorities in the first and second halves of Biden’s term has demonstrated
how much the right majority can move us forward — or backward.

clean_body: [ ]Adam Schiff for Senate Derek — when we win our Senate race here in California this November, we are also going to flip the House of Representatives back to Democratic control. Let me tell you how: They’re known as the “Biden 16” — 16 Republican members of Congress on the ballot in districts that Joe Biden won in 2020 — compared to just 5 Democrats defending Trump-won districts. With 213 Democratic seats in the House, we just need to pick up 5 seats to win a majority — and many of the most competitive are right here in California. If we can fully fund our campaign to turn out voters down-ballot, the Republicans’ House majority is toast. And it will drive enthusiasm across the country to re-elect President Biden and defeat Donald Trump. [ ]Derek, our resources are low after a long, all-parties jungle primary. Add a $10 contribution to help rebuild them. Before my campaign for the Senate, I spent many, many elections helping Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi and congressional Democrats fight for the House majority. One thing those experiences have proven is this: We don’t always have the chance to get big things done, so when the opportunity comes up, we need to take it. I served three full terms in the House before I ever experienced legislating from the majority — not to mention that we were dealing with a Republican Senate and President George W. Bush at the same time! Needless to say, it was not the most productive time in Congress if you were a Democrat. It wasn’t until my fifth term that we had the House and Senate majorities, and President Barack Obama in the White House, to get some real things done. An entire decade. And those majorities didn’t last long — just two years later, the Tea Party movement flipped the House majority in 2010, right in time for redistricting. GOP state legislatures brutally gerrymandered Democrats in dozens of states. It wasn’t for another decade that we once again had the Congress and the White House to pass the urgent priorities that had stacked up over the past decade. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85445221/474781708/-2113420158?source=EM_NBI_JP_20240521_SV_Occupation_0_3MO_JimmyPanetta_NA_NA_Occupation&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTcxODEzMC03YzE4LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nixmvzCFLn83jy2Mc5CgL1VFiSIy3ZH5GTKnhC77F7A=&emci=8609d68e-6918-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=89718130-7c18-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6108787) | Peter,

At the beginning of the year, I asked you to take a moment to share your priorities with me. I’d like to thank everyone who shared their thoughts.

The most common concerns were affordable housing, gun violence, climate change, health care, and essential programs like Social Security and Medicare. Please know that I share these concerns, and I’m working every day to address them.

One of my favorite things to do when I’m out meeting folks in the district is to visit and speak with local employers and employees. Our local businesses are the lifeblood of our community, and knowing what my constituents do during their workday helps me ensure I’m fighting for the right things in Congress.

[If you could, would you please take a moment to tell me about your occupation, how things are going, and what actions we could take in Congress to make things better for you?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85445223/474781730/-1475062164?source=EM_NBI_JP_20240521_SV_Occupation_0_3MO_JimmyPanetta_NA_NA_Occupation&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTcxODEzMC03YzE4LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nixmvzCFLn83jy2Mc5CgL1VFiSIy3ZH5GTKnhC77F7A=&emci=8609d68e-6918-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=89718130-7c18-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6108787) | | [Share Your Thoughts](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85445225/474781738/-1475062164?source=EM_NBI_JP_20240521_SV_Occupation_0_3MO_JimmyPanetta_NA_NA_Occupation&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTcxODEzMC03YzE4LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nixmvzCFLn83jy2Mc5CgL1VFiSIy3ZH5GTKnhC77F7A=&emci=8609d68e-6918-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=89718130-7c18-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=6108787)
---

Friend,

Something you may not know about me is that I'm named after my great-great-grandfather, Silas Burgess, who came to America in the belly of a slave ship.

He was sent to America in shackles and sold to the Burgess Plantation from an auction block in Charleston, South Carolina.

My family's story is like countless others across the country. It is a story of the American Dream that was achieved through the blood, sweat, and tears of those who came before me.

**I've lived the American Dream despite my history and the challenges of adversity during my upbringing. Now, I'm fighting to preserve it since the radical left is making it harder to achieve.**

| [ **SUPPORT MY FIGHT** ](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=e84e66c7786249cb9a6c946fd567fd4f&_e=mRzFhclzCjDWcKBeuHDIeo8Js6L2DJjWlAxjvr1bP72qXtPpcwtGS_6EhTXi8lxHD-GRRyTiX_d-lrtvWuFysi4fy32W4GhWGmi2XvyiVvs8iwNZg-pbnH7QNLT66959hnsjWbD51cTOOandxDPQF1hRlx0rmVdu_l27hjtrbjdAhykvuLM-ZXKBr8LYE8BHCyLvC_iUiNzASzsddzWNy6uHuP2vAyLFLs4BU_OEwlPss1e3r2e3jNxEpuEyibW79cEJxqSvlEXVUjGx3loUlAibyvHaW79KRTV8redCO80hwa3te0JsNkApXweSZoHljXZmWyDkiK1ZMacSnLc-N-lgI6dRHhZPYv2yu8EPYgxXLdK1cn1RZ8EddtRHg5T8DrMIAIECOMuDWrgPsLzXLg%3D%3D)
---

I'm a veteran, Super Bowl champion, and Congressman for Utah's Fourth District. I jumped into the arena to represent my family, those who came before me, and the millions of Black Americans who fight for the betterment of not only their lives and futures but also those of their children.

I've lived the American Dream despite my history and the challenges of adversity during my upbringing. | Peter,

As my time representing Washington's 6th Congressional District comes to a close, I want to take a moment to reflect on the values that have guided my work.

My team’s core mission has been two-fold – **to get government and the economy working better for folks in our region.**

I've worked to strengthen the middle class, ensure our veterans get the benefits they have earned and deserve, give our children a quality education, meet our commitment to our seniors, and protect the region’s rich natural heritage.

This region holds a special place in my heart. It's where I grew up, where I'm raising my own children, and where I've seen firsthand the resilience and spirit of our neck of the woods. That's why it's important to me to ensure that the next representative for this district shares our commitment to these values and has a proven track record of effectively addressing the unique needs of communities across our region.

I'm proud to support Hilary Franz for Washington's 6th Congressional District. _**Hilary's experience working with communities throughout our district and her dedication to service make her the right choice to serve as our next representative.**_

But she can't do it alone.

clean_body: As my time representing Washington's 6th Congressional District comes to a close, I want to take a moment to reflect on the values that have guided my work. | = | Peter, As my time representing Washington's 6th Congressional District comes to a close, I want to take a moment to reflect on the values that have guided my work. My team’s core mission has been two-fold – to get government and the economy working better for folks in our region. I've worked to strengthen the middle class, ensure our veterans get the benefits they have earned and deserve, give our children a quality education, meet our commitment to our seniors, and protect the region’s rich natural heritage. This region holds a special place in my heart. It's where I grew up, where I'm raising my own children, and where I've seen firsthand the resilience and spirit of our neck of the woods. That's why it's important to me to ensure that the next representative for this district shares our commitment to these values and has a proven track record of effectively addressing the unique needs of communities across our region. I'm proud to support Hilary Franz for Washington's 6th Congressional District. Hilary's experience working with communities throughout our district and her dedication to service make her the right choice to serve as our next representative. But she can't do it alone. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for your continued trust and support. Folks, when I say it’s time to get our Montana back, I mean that literally. By refusing to legalize corner crossing, Greg Gianforte continues to **lock up 900,000 acres of our public lands** — all to appease his billionaire buddies. I’m running for Governor to take a stand against Gianforte’s blocking of our access. These are public lands owned by the people — we have the right to hike, hunt, and explore — **_and no wealthy billionaire has the right to block us, especially not the Governor of Montana._** [Will you chip in $50, $25, or $10 to our Montana Movement today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85450483/474800105/1311613515?amount=50&source=SBD_RB_EM_FR_30DO_052224_1_1_Lands&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDgzNDciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzY1NDBjYmItOGIxOC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6COUDNFTrKaV8adhAouQ5DxsJTNKYnlmqc71qSEm_wU=) | | [UNLOCK YOUR STATE 🔓](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85450484/474800106/1311613515?source=SBD_RB_EM_FR_30DO_052224_1_1_Lands&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDgzNDciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzY1NDBjYmItOGIxOC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=6COUDNFTrKaV8adhAouQ5DxsJTNKYnlmqc71qSEm_wU=)

Look, some of the best days of my life have been out hunting and fishing with my family on our beautiful public lands. **The problem is that Greg Gianforte couldn’t care less about Montanans like you and me.**
That’s why he directed his Fish, Wildlife & Parks Director to criminalize corner crossing — a lot of times this is the only way for folks to access public spaces that are otherwise locked out by private lands bought up by greedy billionaires.
It’s no good, and it’s got to go. **_Gianforte has got to go._**

#

Peter, it’s Nichole. Ruben’s Campaign Manager.
I’m going to level with you: We’ve had a few weak fundraising days lately.
Days where we missed our goals.
Look — a bad day here or there isn’t going to sink us. A weak day or two is not the end of this campaign. We can make it up, and more often than not we do.
But when those days turn into weeks, and weeks into months... when we miss consecutive goals... that starts to have a serious effect on our ability to win this race.
Here’s why this is so important: We just put down $19 million in television reservations, an absolutely staggering amount of money. But it’s what we need to do to win in Arizona, one of the most expensive states in the country.
Gave me a bit of heartburn, I’m not going to lie.
Ruben and I check our fundraising every day because it’s emails like this, donations from folks like you, that are going to help us cover the cost of those advertisements. And I need your help if we’re going to turn around the few bad days we’ve had lately.
That’s why I’m writing to you today, and that’s why I have to make this request:
[**I need you to make a donation of $3 — that, or whatever you can afford — and help us get back on track and hit our goals. If we keep on hitting these goals, we will win this race. Overall, we won 68 out of the 78 races that we endorsed in. At least 3 races we weighed in on are headed to a November runoff, which gives us another shot at electing climate champions in those seats. Sadly, we know we lost in 3 races - one of which (House District 33) was a priority race for OLCV. There are still a few races that are too close to call at this point, so we’ll be waiting to see what happens in those races. Thank you for showing your support and voting for climate action! Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, the Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat.

Here’s the truth: Hogan vetoed legislation that would have expanded abortion access for thousands of Marylanders, but he knows that Maryland is a pro-choice state.
And right after the decision to overturn _Roe_ leaked, Larry Hogan refused to release funds that would protect abortion rights for women across this state.

Team,

This past weekend we hosted our 8th Annual Boot Camp Campaign Training with our friends at the National Democratic Training Committee. We hosted nearly 150 future and current candidates, campaign staff, and party leaders for a full-day intensive training about how to run a campaign and win.
We had an incredible turnout, and we were so thrilled we could spend the weekend talking about how to amass Democratic victories in our state, and how to build our bench of candidates, staff, and party leaders for the future.
We’re so grateful for you, our grassroots supporters, who invested in us and ensured we could hold this event and train nearly 150 new candidates, campaign staff, and party leaders. This event continues to be one of the few free in-person campaign trainings available for down-ballot candidates. That is because of your support.
We have plenty of other incredible things planned for the summer and a slate of inspiring candidates we’ll be supporting in the fall, but we can’t do that without you.

They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.primaryupdate.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a94320f0f2474799bd7648fc129af644&_e=yVEWkBaap3VpLivQDM4jcDN7HoQ50mCxV0vJtb3fjlRm9xsSG-y5EuT2KaknimAtBe1XmAU5ZrRcYlSD_vDj9RG0uIZnOgQImmfql7uM6n2T6u9wDsY-lInQ-HGuAPxxUQnlj9_v3YYuVfmO4yoC0K2bYKGCrtJoruQEZB9lnssE0iKKjZ2nTaaHdoiLCZdufs4OGaNh4h2qQSbl6CTcf6ITwX2_RxkfPFP9jrZKe8O7uobUx07ofl1ymoL7B0_eR4hvjkJGVkoMgcx87NWp4BmKKmhfNnqPqxSnEYVtOPB56Ai7_QFWMstlreCT8zIoPoWDBu1RUe4A6mv4yTU1XlTsb4kdp-NeJIEZVeZnM5k0qDjv7xaUcGxWezV8kvi9BD9pgNhTW37nyBKWMDWTZw%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Fellow Conservative,

Barrack Obama is leading a fundraiser for Democratic Senate Candidates on June 5th. **The last time Obama headlined a fundraiser with Bill Clinton, they raked in $26 million for Democrats in a single night.**

This fundraiser, headlined by Barack Obama, will draw in the rich and famous who have limitless money to donate to political causes near and dear to their hearts, and we can’t afford to let Jon Tester pull even further ahead because due to Barack Obama’s entrance into the fray.

The people of Montana will decide who wins this seat, not the special interests, DC lobbyists, and career politicians that fund Jon Tester’s campaigns.

**[I’ll be blunt: if you thought Barack Obama was a failed president, please gift my campaign just a couple of bucks today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d2032666a8584610b6c9a759ea7c4f05&_e=SFBRB3u1aDsPPLFMu1YzXToA1-dK_2xf0L_nQiQkQNGTSjQhRWFuCWHDSDhwCaM67xbvJOmm3i-XVBbiq4xn0pliv6kH3IsVrfLs80nEWPKD9oRkPKRO403ak0RBGtbyvIePJbL1hm-N-E6QAE9uuVEa6PaWAPhp0ecPTRuJ4wkk36reXhrYGfnB5eYTzM0hhwZe9x1AH8aKfO9LPoIZEQDbNRJKMW6dnimXEXFOGuX7_RTdnFB7g2vRSEJzY59ICtigtAoGvmJsc9lSiveJsBm7DD7RPlYr6rqFZ9hU1i8VVqj_bBxTx_fW9IaB1Fcco_UkKgkozwK4Ny6J7MDyDyCwrAD7ghiXN-0Fgj5PWghwm9RK4gKLowGsv8V88irethoXqxFfwBXyd2iamN6aCg%3D%3D)** Your gift will help us show him that his stranglehold on the country's political system is over—once and for all.

Montana knows the truth about Tester’s long career in Washington. Jon is not the moderate he claims to be—he is a radical who has voted against every Republican president he’s served under and pandered to both Democrat presidents who have been in office during his time in the Senate.

Tim Sheehy
